brief: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organized poultry farming among cooperative society members, especially women, by providing financial and technical support for poultry rearing, thereby enhancing income generation and livelihood opportunities in the state.

name: Sports Scholarship (UG) - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹800/- in the form of scholarships to undergraduate students who excel in sports.

name: Krishi Input Anudan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide agricultural input subsidies in affected areas due to the rise in water levels of rivers like Ganga and Kosi and flood-related crop damage from heavy rainfall.

name: Khelo India Scheme: Creation and Upgradation of Sports Infrastructure
brief: The scheme component aims to create and upgrade sports infrastructure across the country by providing financial assistance for modern sports facilities, sports science infrastructure, and sports equipment to eligible entities.

name: Khelo India Scheme: Fit India Movement
brief: The scheme aims to promote physical fitness among all citizens by encouraging regular physical activity, conducting fitness assessments, certifying schools, and organizing fitness campaigns and events.

name: Khelo India Scheme: Khelo India Centres and Sports Academies
brief: The scheme aims to encourage sports across the country by strengthening sports infrastructure, coaching, talent development, and sports academies, thereby promoting excellence in sports and holistic development of children and youth.

name: Khelo India Scheme: Promotion of Inclusiveness through Sports
brief: The scheme aims to promote social inclusion, gender equality, peace, development, and participation in sports by supporting rural and indigenous games, sports for women, persons with disabilities, and youth in disturbed areas across the country.

name: Khelo India Scheme: Sports Competitions and Talent Development
brief: The scheme aims to encourage sports participation, identify and nurture sporting talent, and provide development opportunities through sports competitions, talent development programmes, and community coaching initiatives across India.

name: Khule Jalsroto Mei Pen Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana
brief: The "Khule Jalsroto Mei Pen Aadharit Matsya Paalan ki Yojana" objective of this scheme is to increase fish productivity and production through semi-intensive / intensive fisheries of large-scale available government wetland water sources (Man, Chaur and Lake etc.), strengthening aquaculture through

name: Silkworm Rearing Chamber
brief: The scheme aims to promote sericulture & enhance silk production among farmers by providing financial assistance for establishing dedicated silkworm rearing chambers. Under this scheme, farmers are provided financial support of upto ₹1,00,000 (80:10:10 pattern) for construction of rearing chambers.

name: Janshree Bima Yojana for Khadi Artisans
issuer: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief: The scheme aims to provide insurance cover to Khadi artisans. Through this scheme, group insurance benefits are provided to Khadi artisans (spinners and weavers).

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Compensation Towards Natural Calamities
brief: The scheme aims to financially assist the Goan artists to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their houses damaged due to natural calamities. The maximum financial assistance provided under this component is ₹25,000/- or the valuation done by the Taluka Mamlatdar.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Financial Assistance For Funeral of the Artist
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial relief to the families of deceased Goan artists by assisting them in meeting funeral expenses, thereby acknowledging the contributions of artists and supporting their families during difficult times. The component provides financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/-.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment ventures, helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
brief: The scheme aims to provide a lumpsum grant (maximum ₹20,000/-) to the dependent family in case of death of the artist. The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. The applications are accepted offline.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists. It offers marriage assistance of up to ₹20,000/- for the first daughter and ₹15,000/- for the second daughter of eligible artists.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members for medical treatment expenses. It covers major or minor surgical treatment costs in local or outstation hospitals, including travelling and accommodation expenses.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists who have lost the source of income due to the pandemic. The scheme provides relief in the form of financial assistance amounting to a min. of ₹5,000/- (lumpsum) up to a max. of ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) to eligible artists.

name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support to the wards of recognized Goan artists who are pursuing higher education, thereby addressing the economic challenges faced by artist families in supporting their children's educational aspirations and ensuring continuity of educational opportunities.

name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to provide safe, timely, and free transportation for pregnant women and newborn babies (0 - 1 year) to access healthcare services, including travel from home to the hospital and from the hospital back home.

name: Kantedar Tarbandi Yojana
brief: A initiative of Rajasthan State for the farmer to protect crops from damage caused by Nilgai and stray animals. Financial assistance will be provided to the farmers by the Rajasthan government for fencing their fields.

name: Kisan Kaleva Yojana
brief: Under the Kisan Kaleva Scheme run by the Rajasthan Government, food is provided at concessional rates through coupons to the farmers and their assistants who come to sell crops in the vegetable market premises.

name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)
brief: The scheme "Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (General)" aims to improve agricultural market infrastructure by providing financial assistance to Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) for developing modern facilities.

name: Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal)
brief: The scheme “Kishan Kalpvriksh Yojana (Scheme for Assistance to APMCs to Provide Basic and Modern Facilities) (Tribal)” aims to strengthen agricultural markets by providing financial assistance for the modernization and development of basic facilities to Cooperative Market Committees in tribal areas.

name: Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam
brief: The scheme is designed to support economically disadvantaged families belonging to the SC/ST and minority communities by providing one-time financial assistance for the marriage of their daughters.

name: Kam Lagat Pyaaj Bhandaran Sanrachna
brief: Under the Kam Lagat Pyaaj Bhandaran Sanrachna yojana Construction of warehouses should be done at a high level to prevent moisture and dampness which occur due to direct contact of onions with soil.

name: Krushi Mahotsav
brief: The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana is an agricultural development scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat in the year 2010. The scheme aims to boost agricultural productivity and increase the income of farmers in the state.

name: Khel Mahakumbh
brief: The scheme "Khel Mahakumbh" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote sports culture and identify grassroots talent through cash prizes and structured competitions, benefiting all individuals and students across Gujarat.

name: Kailash Mansarovar Yatra- Madhya Pradesh
brief: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the pilgrims of the state going on the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra. Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/- per pilgrim.

name: Kailash Mansarovar Yatra Scheme 2016
brief: The scheme “Kailash Mansarovar Yatra Scheme 2016” was launched by the Tourism Department, Government of Haryana on 12th July 2016. Under the scheme, the government of Haryana provides financial assistance to the pilgrims of the State of Haryana.

name: Karmaveer Padmashri Dadasaheb Gaikwad Birth Centenary And Prize Distribution
brief: The "Karmaveer Padmashri Dadasaheb Gaikwad Birth Centenary and Prize Distribution" is an award by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The award is given to individuals and organizations working for the social movement against traditional customs and untouchability and for landless farm workers.

name: Organising Sports Competitions and Training Camps
brief: The scheme aims to promote sports at the grassroots levels by providing structured training, organizing competitions & nurturing sporting talent. Training is conducted through local camps in all districts for various sports, including football, athletics, boxing, volleyball, etc. with minimal fees.

name: Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize
brief: The scheme "Kamban Pugazh Literary Prize" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide prizes of ₹10,000/- and 10 awards to the author in the field of novels, short stories, drama, poems & prose in Tamil.

name: Khel Pratibha Puraskar
brief: The scheme “Khel Pratibha Puraskar” by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to recognize and encourage sportspersons by providing cash prizes ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹5,00,00,000 to national and international medal winners across the state.

name: Kalyanamastu Pathakam Scheme - Andhra Pradesh
brief: The "Kalyanamastu Pathakam Scheme - Andhra Pradesh" aims to encourage girls to marry the boys living in Andhra Pradesh who are getting their livelihood through Vaidikam, a one-time financial assistance of ₹75,000/- will be granted. In order to encourage Vedic culture as well.

name: Farmer Pension Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support to elderly farmers residing in the state of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1200/- is provided to farmers who are above 60 years of age, own up to 2 hectares of land, and cultivate their own land.

name: Kisan Parivahan Yojana
brief: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing medium-sized goods vehicles to facilitate the transportation of agricultural produce.

name: Khiladi Protsahan Yojana
brief: In 2017, the Madhya Pradesh Labour Department initiated the Khilaadee Protsaahan Yojana to provide financial assistance to players.

name: Kumar Rajratna Bhimrao Ambedkar Medical Assistance Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals belonging to SC category suffering from incurable & serious diseases. Under this scheme, Medical Assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste patients diagnosed with life-threatening conditions such as TB, Leukemia, & other critical illnesses.

name: Khushi Scheme
brief: The Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Odisha had introduced a scheme named "Khushi" which aims to provide Free sanitary napkins to all girls in Government and aided schools from class 6th to 12th.

name: Kharmore Sonchidia Award Scheme
brief: In the scheme "Kharmore Sonchidia Award" by the Forest Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, the farmers are rewarded with ₹5,000/- if a Kharmor bird is sighted in the private land of the farmer and ₹10,000/- if a Golden bird is sighted in the private land of the farmer.

name: Kanyadaan Scheme (CBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be granted to the workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the eve of the marriage of his/her daughter and self-marriage of female registered workers.

name: KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme
brief: The scheme “KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme” helps to provide opportunity to superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective field of specialization and to harness their knowledge and erudition for the development of State.

name: KSCSTE Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme
brief: KSCSTE Post-Doctoral Fellowships will be provided to those who possess Ph.D. in science and engineering with high quality research publications in SCI journals. The program aims to encourage Ph.D. holders to pursue further research and to develop career as scientist.

name: KSCSTE Research Fellowship
brief: The scheme “KSCSTE Research Fellowship” is for encouraging enthusiastic and passionate post-graduate science/ engineering students by supporting them financially in their Ph.D. studies.

name: Karkhandar Scheme For Development Of Craft Sector
brief: A training and skilling upgradation scheme by the Dept. of Industries & Commerce and implemented by the Directorate of Handicraft & Handloom, Govt. of Jammu & Kashmir wherein passout meritorious trainees and ex-trainees from departmental training centers are are provided skill upgradation training.

name: Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.

name: Kashyapa Scheme for Food & Shelter
brief: The "Kashyapa Scheme for Food & Shelter" aims to help poor, orphan children, differently-abled individuals, widows, destitute women separated from their husbands, and elderly Brahmins with financial assistance for meeting their food and shelter expenses. This scheme covers 13 districts of the state.

name: Kanyadaan Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of ₹51,000/- in the form of Kanyadaan to registered construction workers on the occasion of the marriage of their daughters. This assistance is available for up to three daughters of the worker.

name: Konkani Song & Music Awards (Tiatr Kantaram)
brief: The scheme aims to encourage producers, lyricists, singers, and musicians to produce qualitative Konkani Audio/Video/Digital albums of Tiatr songs. Cash awards from ₹5,000/- to ₹30,000/- are provided across twelve categories to Goan artists producing Konkani kantaram albums.

name: Kerala Stressed MSMEs Revival & Rehabilitation Scheme
brief: The “Kerala Stressed MSMEs Revival & Rehabilitation Scheme” intends to provide financial and other handholding support to the MSMEs which show signs of stress and to convert their non-productive assets into productive assets.

name: Karma Sathi Prakalpa
brief: The scheme aims to help young entrepreneurs in the state establish new manufacturing enterprises and small businesses, including those offering services and trading. The scheme offers soft loans and subsidies for new income-generating projects.

name: Kishor Swasthya Paramarsh Clinic - Uttarakhand
brief: This initiative aims to promote the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of adolescents aged 10 to 19 years by providing free health counselling and guidance.

name: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana
brief: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to motivate girls towards education. Under this scheme, girls in Class 11th who have passed their 10th class examination will receive ₹3,000/- per year as a monetary incentive.

name: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana (For Scheduled Caste Girls)
brief: Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste girls who pass the Class 10th and enroll in the Class 11th at a government or recognized institution and study regularly are given an incentive of ₹3,000/- per year.

name: Kala Samman Scheme
brief: The scheme "Kala Samman Scheme" grants financial assistance to eminent artists who are in indigent circumstances as a token of respect for their contribution to the field of Art and culture.

name: Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme Karnataka
brief: The "Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in the leather industry. The goal is to promote self-sufficiency and economic independence by enabling these women to start or expand business activities related to leatherwork.

name: Kushal Shramik Sahay Yojana (GBOCWWB)
brief: Under the scheme, assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers and their children for career development. By advancing in skill education, the children of construction workers can also progress and avail employment opportunities.

name: Kanya Sumangala Yojana
brief: Various schemes are run by the government for the purpose of providing social security to women, Kanya Sumangala Yojana is one such scheme.

name: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana - Chhattisgarh
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Kisan Samriddhi Yojana" for farmer.

name: Kisan Suryoday Yojana (KSY)
brief: "Kisan Suryoday Yojana (KSY)" is a Gujarat government initiative launched in 2020-2021 to provide daytime electricity for agricultural activities, utilizing solar and non-conventional energy.

name: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
brief: The "Kaidi Sahay Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to the family of a prisoner who is the sole or main earner, to support them through self-employment.

name: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana Jharkhand
brief: The "Kisan Samriddhi Yojana" by the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Cooperative, Government of Jharkhand, promotes solar-powered irrigation systems to reduce agricultural costs and dependency on fossil fuels. Farmers receive up to 90% subsidy for solar units under this initiative.

name: Kalyani Sahayata Yojana (Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Board)
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹6,000/- every six months (totaling ₹12,000/- per year) will be provided to the wife of a deceased worker employed in an industrial unit or establishment in Madhya Pradesh.

name: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards
brief: The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council.

name: Khet Talai
brief: Under the Khet Talai scheme, the Rajasthan Government gives subsidies to the farmers on the construction of farm ponds so that the farmers can collect rainwater and irrigate their fields by making farm ponds in their fields.

name: Silkworm Rearing Equipment
brief: The scheme aims to support individuals in silkworm rearing by providing necessary equipment, financial assistance, and technical guidance. Under this scheme, financial assistance of upto ₹40,000/- is provided to individuals for procuring essential equipment required for silkworm rearing.

name: Krishak Utpadak Kshati Sahayata Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and compensation to farmers in the event of loss or damage to crops, livestock, or agricultural land caused by fire, flood, or heavy rains in the notified areas of the state.

name: Kala Utsav Pratiyogita - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to promote and encourage artistic talent among school students of Classes 9 to 12.

name: Karma Veer Dadasaheb Gaikwad Sabalikaran & Swabhiman Yojana
brief: The main objective of this scheme is to improve the financial condition of the scheduled castes and Nav-Buddhists who are landless workers and are from "Below Poverty Line". Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible. This scheme is 100% funded by the State Govt.

name: Kisan Vriksha Mitra Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to promote commercial tree plantation on private lands, ensuring buyback of produce, increasing farmers' income, and generating employment. The scheme benefits farmers, private institutions, and other stakeholders by providing financial assistance for plantation.

name: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide merit-based financial assistance to children of CM-KISAN beneficiaries pursuing professional and technical courses, supporting higher education through Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme
brief: ‘Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme’ was relaunched in the year 2014 by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry Of Finance, Government of India in view of the popular demand and to revitalize Small Savings. The amount invested in Kisan Vikas Patra (KYP) doubles in 115 months at the present rate.

name: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana
brief: The KVPY is a national fellowship program in basic sciences, initiated and funded by the Department of Science and Technology to attract exceptionally motivated students to pursue basic science courses and a research career in science.

name: Kanya Vivah Sahayta Yojana
brief: The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for marriageable daughters of beneficiary registered labourers and registered women construction labourers working in the building and other construction processes and to encourage legal arrangements.

name: Kaushal Vikas Yojana
brief: The Uttar Pradesh Kaushal Vikas Mission (UPSDM) is a scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to equip young people in the state with the necessary skills for employment.

name: Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana - Karnataka
brief: The “Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana” aims to sustain and develop the handloom weaving skills of existing weavers and to attract young talent to the industry, thus preserving the rich cultural heritage of handloom weaving in Karnataka.

name: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana
issuer: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief: The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

name: Krishi Yantra
brief: In the Krishi Yantra scheme, the farmer purchases farming-related equipment from an authorized dealer, then the state government gives a subsidy to the farmers.

name: Krishonnati Yojana - Sub Mission On Seed And Planting Material (SMSP)
issuer: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
brief: The Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) aims to increase the production of certified / quality seed, increase SRR, upgrade the quality of farm-saved seeds, strengthen the seed multiplication chain, promote new technologies and methodologies in seed production, processing, testing, etc.

name: Kutirjyoti Yojana Gujarat
brief: The scheme aims to provide free household electricity connections to Scheduled Tribe families in tribal areas.

name: LIDCOM 50% Subsidy Scheme
brief: The "50% Subsidy Scheme" is a scheme by LIDCOM, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, 50% amount is being given as a subsidy on a maximum loan amount of ₹50,000/-. The subsidy is subject to the maximum limit of ₹10,000/-. The bank charge of interest is as per the existing rate.

name: Lalima Abhiyaan
brief: The Lalima Abhiyaan aims to improve the health of children, adolescent girls, and women of reproductive age, and focuses on the prevention of anemia and nutrition awareness among adolescent girls.

name: Labour Accident benefit Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to workers (Shramyogis) who become disabled during their duty period due to an accident or any other reason at the working premises of the establishment.

name: Loans and Advances for Construction of a House
brief: The "Loans and Advances for Construction of a House" scheme by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial support to registered construction workers to build their own houses. Beneficiaries can avail loans based on their skill level, with amounts ranging.

name: Awarding Laptops To Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya
brief: The aims to award laptops to meritorious students of Board Examination. Through this scheme, laptops are provided to eligible students who meet the published merit criteria.

name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme
brief: The scheme “Laxman Award/Rani Laxmi Bai Award” was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttar Pradesh to honor special sports personalities of the state. The Laxman award is to male sportspersons and the Rani Laxmi Bai award is given to female sportspersons.

name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme- Differently-abled and Posthumously
brief: The scheme “Laxman Award/Rani Laxmi Bai Award” was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttar Pradesh to honor special sports personalities of the state, differently-abled players and the Laxman Award, the highest sports award of the state will be given posthumously to Shahid.

name: Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training
brief: The scheme was commenced in the year 1987 with the objective to provide financial assistance to bright Scheduled Castes Students who want to undergo training for commercial pilot license.

name: Legal Aid To Scheduled Castes And Vimukat Jatis Scheme
brief: The scheme “Legal Aid to Scheduled Castes and Vimukat Jatis Scheme” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Schedule Castes and Backward Classes, Haryana on 13th February 1961.

name: Ladli Beti Scheme
brief: A social assistance scheme sponsored by the J&K Govt. for newborn girl children born on or after 01/04/2015. The objective is to arrest the declining female sex ratio. The scheme ensures that the girl child does not become a burden for the parent or guardian at the time of her marriage.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
brief: The "Lakshmir Bhandar" scheme is a flagship program to provide financial assistance to women from economically weaker sections of society, for the empowerment of women in the age group of 25-60 years, and enrolled in ‘Swasthya Sathi’.

name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Education Loan
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The scheme aims to provide education loans to the students from the community of safai karamcharis\manual scavengers & their dependents for pursuing higher education.

name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - General Term Loan (GTL)
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: A general term loan scheme by the Ministry of Social justice and Empowerment for Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers, and their dependants aged 18 years and above.

name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Sanitary Marts Scheme
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: A sanitary mart is a one-stop-shop for all things for sanitation and hygiene. It is a shopping place where the sanitary needs of the common man could be met. It serves both as a shop and as a service centre.

name: Loan based Scheme for Pay and Use Community Toilets
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The “Pay and Use” Community Toilets Scheme under Swachhta Udyami Yojana by NSKFDC offers concessional loans to Safai Karamcharis and their dependents for setting up public toilet units, promoting sanitation, livelihood, and dignity.

name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Swachhta Udyami Yojana – Swachhta Se Sampannta Ki Aur
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The scheme aims to ensure mechanised cleaning and provide related safe and sustainable livelihood opportunities to Safai Karamcharis and liberated Manual Scavengers. The Financial assistance is provided for the procurement and operation of sanitation-related equipment and vehicles for the target.

name: Lakshmi Bai Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana
brief: Lakshmi Bai Social Security Scheme has been launched by the Bihar government for the widow women of the state.

name: Land/Built-Up Area Rebate Scheme
brief: "Land/Built-Up Area Rebate Scheme" by the Dept. of IT, Govt. of Goa. The scheme aims to provide Land / Built-up Area Rebate to the IT Industry in the state of Goa. A one-time rebate for the purchase of Land for creating IT Office Space and for the purchase of Built-Up office space for IT operations.

name: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (nos)
brief: The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom.

name: Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rainwater harvesting structure(nos)
brief: The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom

name: Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award
brief: The scheme provides a prestigious annual award consisting of a shawl, memento, citation, and cash purse of ₹50,000/-, with recognition given at a special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the release of the first Konkani film 'Mogacho Anvddo' by late Al-Jerry Braganza.

name: Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards
brief: The scheme aims to recognize veteran Khell/Khell-Tiatr artistes who have made significant contributions to this traditional art form. It honors deserving artistes with lifetime achievement awards and cash burse.

name: Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card
brief: Under  this facilities, a labour card is issued to workers engaged in construction, repair, maintenance, and related activities, enabling them to avail the benefits of all welfare schemes provided by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare

name: Living Craft Treasure Award
brief: The "Living Craft Treasure Award" scheme was launched by the Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles, and Khadi Department, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. This is the highest award for handicrafts at the state level was introduced in the year 2013-2014 to craftsperson of eminence who are above the age of 65 years.

name: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial)
brief: The scheme aims to recognize and honor tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music in the past, addressing the need to acknowledge their lifetime dedication to this traditional art form. The scheme provides a comprehensive recognition package.

name: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial)
brief: The scheme recognizes and honors non-commercial artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music through yearly Tiatr Festivals/Competitions organized by Kala Academy and by organizing tiatrs in villages, as well as artistes who have enriched Konkani Tiatr.

name: Lakhpati Didi Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief: The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the economic status of women in Uttarakhand by empowering them to become financially self-reliant and achieve the status of “Lakhpati Didis.”

name: Logistics Excellence, Advancement, and Performance Shield
brief: The scheme aims to acknowledge and celebrate best practices and innovations in the logistics industry across sectors. It also aims to promote sustainability, efficiency, and technological advancement in alignment with national logistics initiatives.

name: LIDCOM Education Loan Scheme
brief: The "Education Loan Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, finance of upto ₹ 20,00,000 is provided for post graduate students in the 18-50 years age group from Charmakar Community for studies in India and in abroad.

name: Laptop-e Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to equip Class XI students with individual portable computer systems to enhance digital learning, knowledge acquisition, and skill attainment for employment or self-employment. Students receive one entry-level Laptop or Notebook equipped with specific technical requirements.

name: Loan For Commercial Pilot Training
brief: The scheme aims to offer affordable loans of up to ₹25,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate to tribal students who want to pursue pilot training.

name: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY.

name: License for Repairers of Weights-Measures and Weighing Instruments
brief: Under this scheme, a government-approved license is issued to repairers of weights and measuring instruments, enabling them to repair such instruments used by traders as a means of self-employment and to ensure their livelihood.

name: Loan For Foreign Study (E.B.C.)
brief: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Educationally Backward Class (EBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to EBC students.

name: Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)
brief: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to SEBC students.

name: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to support fishers by providing financial assistance for live fish vending centers. A subsidy per unit is provided under PMMSY.

name: LIDCOM Gattai Stall Scheme
brief: Being implemented by LIDCOM, Govt. of Maharashtra for the Roadsides Cobblers from the (Scheduled Caste) Charmakar Community, this scheme provides a 100% subsidy for the erection of a Tin Stall of Size 4’ x 5’ x 6.5’ costing ₹16367/- per stall and ₹500/- incidental charges.

name: Livestock Health and Diseases Control
issuer: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
brief: The Livestock Health and Diseases Control (LH&DC) scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India.

name: Life Saving Technique Water Sports Operator
brief: The scheme aims to train youth of the state as certified trainers and operators in water life-saving techniques. Under this scheme, training opportunities are provided to selected beneficiaries to develop water safety and rescue skills.

name: National Livestock Mission: Livestock Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
brief: The scheme aims to provide insurance coverage to livestock in order to protect cattle rearers against the loss of their animals due to death, thereby encouraging them to adopt better animal husbandry practices.

name: Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship
brief: The scheme "Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department aims to promote classical music education by providing annual scholarships to eligible Gurus and their disciples across Gujarat.

name: Lakshadweep Scholarship Scheme
brief: The Lakshadweep Scholarship Scheme is a government initiative aimed at providing financial assistance to students from Lakshadweep pursuing higher education.

name: LLB Internship Programme
brief: Department of Justice introduced an Internship Programme for young law students. The purpose is to well acquaint law students in the field of research & referencing work, in various specialized areas of justice delivery, such as Tele-Law, Nyaya Bandhu etc.

name: Laadli Laxmi Scheme
brief: Laadli Laxmi Scheme was launched with the intention to address the undesirable tendency of female foeticides and with an aim towards erasing the general perception that the birth of a girl in the family is a burden on her parents/guardian during her marriage.

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
brief: Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been started in Madhya Pradesh for Girl Child in 2007.

name: LIDCOM Margin Money Loan Scheme
brief: In this scheme, for a loan limit from ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000/-, 20% of the Project cost loan as Seed Capital is paid by the Corporation @ 4% interest per annum. A maximum of ₹10,000/- will be paid as a subsidy by Corporation. A 5% amount of project cost will have to be contributed by the beneficiary.

name: Livestock Mission Scheme - Interest Payment on Loan
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities at the local level by encouraging livestock-based entrepreneurship and reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries through payment of 90% of the bank loan interest by the State Government.

name: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among persons with disabilities through grants, term loans, and margin money assistance.

name: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Caste)
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Castes. It provides financial aid, including loans, margin money, and grants, for livelihood projects.

name: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes)
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Tribe individuals through financial support, including loans, margin money, and grants.

name: Low Altitude Guide Course
brief: The scheme aims to train and certify youth from Uttarakhand as professional low altitude guides and provide them with skill development opportunities to strengthen their role in the state’s tourism sector.

name: Land Ports Authority Of India (LPAI) Internship Scheme
brief: The Land Ports Authority of India (LPAI) is pleased to announce its annual internship program for the academic year 2025-26. This program provides a unique opportunity for students and research scholars from BBIN countries (Bhutan, India, Nepal, and Bangladesh) to gain practical experience in LPAI

name: Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief: The objective of the scheme is to encourage the children of laborers who are enrolled in professional or design courses by providing assistance for purchasing laptops, thereby reducing the financial burden of education.

name: Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme
brief: The scheme “Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme” was launched by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs, Government of West Bengal in 2014 to revive the Folk and Tribal Culture in their respective genre across various zones and districts in the State.

name: Leprosy Pension Scheme
brief: This Leprosy Pension Scheme has been started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Uttar Pradesh.

name: Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)
brief: "Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Dept of Labour and Employment, Govt of Goa. Through this scheme, the worker registered with the Board is provided with a loan of ₹5,000/- for the purchase of tools.

name: Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers
brief: "Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides an amount not exceeding ₹20,000/- as loan to the members of the fund, for the purchase of work related tools.

name: Laado Protsahan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to encourage the birth of girl children in poor families and promote their holistic development. Under this scheme, financial support ₹1,50,000/- is provided in seven installments to the parents or guardians of girls born in Government/authorized Medical Institutions.

name: Lease Rental Rebate Scheme for Goan Diaspora
brief: The "Lease Rental Rebate Scheme for Goan Diaspora" is one of the "IT Policy Schemes" by the Dept of IT, Govt of Goa. The objective is to provide Lease Rental Rebate for Goan Diaspora. A 100% reimbursement of the lease rentals will be provided for a period of first 6 months of operations.

name: Lease Rental Subsidy Scheme
brief: Launched in 2018, the "Lease Rental Subsidy Scheme" is one of the "Information Technology Policy Schemes" by the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa. The objective and the scope of this scheme is to provide Lease Rental Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in Goa.

name: Lakshya Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support in the form of scholarships to candidates who are permanent residents of Tripura and clear the Civil Service Examination (Prelims/Mains) conducted by UPSC.

name: Livelihood Support To Marine Fishermen During Fishing Ban Period
brief: Livelihood Support to Marine Fishermen during the Fishing Ban Period scheme under the Department of Fisheries & Animal Resources Development, Government of Odisha aims to support the livelihood of marine fisher families.

name: Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society For Interest Free Loan
brief: The scheme provides interest-free loans to citizens through a cooperative society. The maximum loan amount offered is ₹45,000/-, with zero interest charged.

name: Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society: Jewel Loan (Interest Free)
brief: The scheme offers citizens interest-free loans up to ₹1,00,000/- on jewels, helping them meet various financial needs without the burden of interest rates.

name: Large Sized Multi-Purpose Coop. Society: Medium Term Loan to Tribal Members
brief: The scheme offers medium-term loans of up to ₹60,000/- without interest to tribal members, enabling them to fulfill various financial needs.

name: Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST
brief: The scheme "Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST" by the Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Government of Goa aims to provide laptops to the meritorious students who were born in Goa.

name: Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme
brief: Launched on 1st January 2006, the “Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme” is a flagship social-security scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. The family receives ₹2,750/- per month for 15 years after either of the two parents completes 45 years of age.

name: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension (Police Line Yojana) for the democracy fighters of the state imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the emergency period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹20,000/- to the democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977).

name: Loktantra Senani Samman Pension Scheme for Widowed Wife or Widower Husband of Democracy Fighters of the State Imprisoned under MISA/DIR during Emergency Period (from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977)
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹20,000/- to the widowed wife or widower husband of democracy fighters of the state who were imprisoned under MISA/DIR during the Emergency period from 25.06.1975 to 21.03.1977.

name: Labour Skill Training Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
brief: Launched on 1st August 2018, the scheme "Labour Skill Training Scheme" is a skill development initiative by the Building and Other Construction Workers Board, Govt of MP. It offers free skill training to construction workers aged 18-45 years and their dependents aged 16-45

name: Labor Tool Assistance Scheme
brief: Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Labor Tools Assistance Scheme has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh.

name: Leave Travelling Concession Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Leave Travelling Concession Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides leave travel concession to the registered construction workers for journeys to religious/ historical places in India or visiting their hometown.

name: Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)
brief: The scheme "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial loan assistance of up to ₹25,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum is provided to Unreserved category candidates for pursuing commercial pilot training.

name: Leave Travel Concession Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief: Under this scheme, an amount of ₹1,500/- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial institutions of the state of Haryana in the form of Leave Travel Concession (LTC) for travel once in a block of 4 years.

name: Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
brief: Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research aims to provide advanced training in India and abroad to medical and health research personnel in cutting-edge research areas related to medicine and health.

name: Long Term-Loan to SC Co-op Spinning Mills under Special Component Plan
brief: The scheme "Long Term-Loan to SC Co-op Spinning Mills under Special Component Plan" was introduced by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to promote the development of spinning mills owned by scheduled caste members.

name: Loans for Tools (MBOCWWB)
brief: Under the scheme, a one-time grant will be granted to all members of the fund for the purchase of tools subject to the conditions.

name: LIDCOM Training Scheme
brief: Being implemented particularly for the Charmakar Community, the "Training Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. This scheme is being implemented for the students to enable them to start their own businesses, trade, or get a job.

name: Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad
brief: The scheme's purpose is to offer financial assistance to tribal students for higher education abroad. It provides a loan of up to ₹15,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate.

name: Ladies Vocational Centres
brief: The Government of Jammu And Kashmir started “Ladies Vocational Centres” with the objective is to impart training in various trades i.e. Cutting, Embroidery, Knitting as well as Stenography to the female folk to enable them to start their income-generating units.

name: Laghu Vyavassay Scheme
brief: "Laghu Vyavassay Scheme" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Govt of Haryana. In this scheme, loans are provided to individuals from Scheduled Castes for self-employment/ income-generating activities.

name: Lab on Wheels
brief: This program has been launched to promote & popularize science education among school students and youth studying science subjects across all 13 districts of Uttarakhand.

name: Labour Welfare Scheme (Health)
brief: The scheme aims to provide comprehensive health care and financial assistance for medical treatments. It offers hospital services, medical reimbursements, and subsistence allowances for beedi, cine, and non-coal mine workers and their dependants.

name: Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana
brief: The Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana, is a health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat on 4th September 2012. It was initially launched only to cater to people who fall under the lowest income groups of the state i.e. Below Poverty Line (BPL).

name: Medical Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: Medical assistance shall be provided to Building & Other Construction Workers who are registered under A.B.O.C.W.W.B. during hospitalization, partial disability & for critical diseases such as Cancer, Heart attack, Failure of kidney, Liver cirrhosis etc. as per the decision of the Board.

name: Marriage Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
issuer: Government of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
brief: Under this scheme, registered construction workers will receive a financial allowance to cover either their own marriage expenses or those of their two dependent children.

name: Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)
brief: Through the "Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)" scheme, the worker who is hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or any disease is provided with ₹400/- for the first 5 days and ₹40/- for the remaining days, subject to a maximum ₹2,000/-.

name: Merit Awards
brief: In the "Merit Awards" scheme, awards are given to the students with disability who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd among disabled students in the Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C.) and Higher Secondary Certificate (H.S.C.)  in their respective divisional boards of education.

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief: "Marriage Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. In this scheme, financial assistance of ₹7,000/- is provided to the registered construction workers of the Board for the marriage of their children. The benefits are credited via DBT.

name: Marriage Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The scheme “Marriage Assistance” was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B), Labour Welfare Department, Government of Assam for providing financial assistance to the registered construction workers for the marriage of their children.

name: Medical Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
issuer: Government of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
brief: The scheme provides medical assistance to the Building & Other Construction Workers, who are registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, and his/her dependents' family members during hospitalization due to accident or illness.

name: Medical Assistance (APB&OCWWB)
brief: The scheme “Medical Assistance” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Aarogya Yojana
brief: The Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana, launched on 1 May 2021, aims to reduce medical expenses by offering free treatment for 1,798 procedures in government and empanelled private hospitals. Eligible NFSA, SECC 2011 families, contract workers, small farmers, and others can avail benefits.

name: Mukhyamantri Aanchal Amrit Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to improve the health of children between 3 to 6 years of age by providing them fortified and flavored milk containing Vitamins A and D, four days a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

name: Mukhyamantri Aawasiye Bhu-Adhikaar Yojana
brief: Revenue Department of Madhya Pradesh State started this scheme to provide residential plots.

name: Maintenance Allowance To Backward Class Students Under Training In Sainik Schools
brief: The scheme “Maintenance Allowance to Backward Class Students Under Training in Sainik School” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra.

name: Meghalaya Any Business Venture Scheme
brief: The Meghalaya Any Business Ventures Scheme, part of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program, provides financial support to 50 entrepreneurs across the state to start their own businesses.

name: Scholarship on Merit Basis
brief: The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate studies at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University by awarding scholarships to those who secure the highest marks in the relevant course, class, or subject.

name: Marriage Assistance To Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II)
brief: The scheme “Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Differently Abled Parents (Parinayam-I)
brief: The scheme “Marriage Assistance to Daughters of Differently Abled Parents (Parinayam-I)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Madilu Kit
brief:
The Madilu Programme is a government initiative focused on empowering rural communities through skill development and entrepreneurship opportunities.
It aims to create sustainable livelihoods, reduce poverty, and enhance social and economic well-being in rural areas.

name: Marriage Assistance To Daughters Of Prisoners
brief: The scheme “Marriage Assistance to Daughters of Prisoners” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Maulana Azad Education Finance Foundation Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide interest-free loans of up to ₹5 lakh to students from minority communities for pursuing higher education in India and abroad.

name: Marriage Assistance - Folk Artist
brief: The scheme "Marriage Assistance" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. This scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of registered folk artists, or their son or daughter. The assistance aims to support the cultural community by helping with marriage.

name: Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief: The "Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme  that provides maternity benefits of ₹ 30,000/- to the registered women members and wives of male members for upto 2 children.

name: Maternity Assistance for the Construction Worker
brief: The "Maternity Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides maternity benefits in the form of financial assistance to the eligible  registered women members of the board.

name: Maintenance Allowance for Leprosy Affected Persons
brief: The 'Maintenance Allowance for Leprosy Affected Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to leprosy-affected persons.

name: Maintenance Allowance for Persons Affected with Muscular Dystrophy
brief: The 'Maintenance Allowance for Persons Affected with Muscular Dystrophy' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to the person affected with muscular dystrophy.

name: Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief: "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" was launched by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept, Delhi. The registered workers are given medical assistance upto ₹ 10,000/- in case of being hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or disease.

name: Marriage Assistance for the Construction Workers
brief: The "Marriage Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides Marriage benefits in the form of financial assistance to the eligible registered women members & their immediate dependents of the board.

name: Medical Assistance for the Construction Worker
brief: The "Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers" by the Sikkim BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, is a welfare scheme of the board that provides medical expenses for the treatment of the registered beneficiary and /or his dependents.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati / Anusuchit Janjati Udyami Yojana
brief: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance for setting up businesses.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Evam Anusuchit Janjati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana
brief: The “Mukhyamantri Anusoochit Jaati Evam Anusoochit Janajati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana” was launched by the SC and ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar aims to provide financial assistance in every month to the students studying in Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe hostels.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana
brief: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Janjati Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to uplift Scheduled Tribe communities through education, health, & economic initiatives. Financial grants, equipment, & training programs are provided for holistic village development.

name: Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana
brief: The Mukhyamantri Aadim Jan Jati Pension Yojana, launched on 08-07-2015 by the Jharkhand Government, provides financial assistance to primitive tribal families. The pension is given to the adult married woman or, if none, the male head of the family.

name: Marriage Assistance (JKBOCWWB)
brief: The "Marriage Assistance" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial aid to registered construction workers for the marriage of their dependents, including up to three marriages for their sons, daughters, siblings, or themselves.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana
brief: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana" under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance for special project proposals received in the interest of the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.

name: Medical Assistance (Karmika Arogya Bhagya) (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Medical Assistance (Karmika Arogya Bhagya)'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to registered construction workers and their dependents for hospitalisation expenses in recognised hospitals.

name: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy Scheme
brief: The MAKA Trophy instituted in year 1956-57 is a rolling trophy awarded by the Ministry of Sports to the overall top performing University in sports of the preceding year for promoting competitive sports in the university sector with a view to arouse keen interest among students.

name: Marriage Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Marriage Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial support to registered construction workers for the marriage expenses of their own or their two (2) dependent children's marriages.

name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Ijjat Monthly Season Ticket Card Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Ijjat Monthly Season Ticket Card Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 December 2017.

name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakaar Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 28 April 2012.

name: Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
brief: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Industrial Policy and Investment Promotion, Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st August 2014.

name: Marriage Assistance For Legally Married Transgender Couples
brief: The scheme “Marriage Assistance for Legally Married Transgender Couples” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. This scheme is intended to help deprived transgender individuals who are planning to get married legally to lead a steady normal family life.

name: Mamata Scheme
brief: In order to improve the process in curbing the high rate of mortality and infant mortality rate, the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Odisha introduced a scheme named "MAMATA" - a conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme.

name: Medical Assistance (MBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered construction workers who are hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.

name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Mazdoor Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide social and financial welfare benefits to unorganized sector workers. It offers increased remuneration, seasonal bonuses, electricity subsidies, and assistance such as e-rickshaws to registered unorganized laborers in Madhya Pradesh.

name: Manav Garima Yojna SCW (EBC)
brief: The scheme aims to assist the economically backward class in becoming self-employed through the distribution of business tool-kits that help them establish small-scale ventures and earn a sustainable livelihood.

name: Manav Garima Yojana DCW (Minority)
brief: The scheme aims to enable minority persons to become self-employed through business toolkits and support. Under this scheme, business tool-kits are provided to eligible persons from such groups, so they can set up small businesses.

name: Manav Garima Yojna (NT DNT)
brief: The scheme aims to enable nomadic and de-notified castes to live with dignity and become self-employed. Through this scheme, business tool-kits are provided to these beneficiaries to help them start small businesses and achieve financial self-sufficiency.

name: Medical Assistance (NBOCWWB)
brief: The "Medical Assistance" scheme by the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to registered beneficiaries and their family members for hospitalization.

name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students
brief: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students was launched in 2009 by the Ministry of Minority Affairs for providing financial aid to students for their higher studies.

name: Marriage Assistance (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The “Marriage Assistance” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for girl children (upto 2 children) of the registered female building workers.

name: Marriage Assistance to Person with Disability / BPL
brief: The scheme aims to support differently-abled brides/bridegrooms from BPL families by providing financial assistance to meet marriage-related expenses. Under this scheme, an amount of ₹30,000/- is provided to Scheduled Tribe, differently-abled brides/bridegrooms for their first marriage.

name: Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana
brief: Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Avivahita Pension Yojana" for unmarried women of the state.

name: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide ₹10,000/- as a one-time scholarship to extremely backward class students passing class 10th in the first division from the Bihar School Examination Board.

name: Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana
brief: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

name: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste
brief: By the Chandigarh Government, this scheme is initiated to reduce the financial burden for the girl marriage. Under the scheme financial assistance will be provided.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide loans of up to ₹5,00,000/- at a simple annual interest rate of 5% to youths from minority communities (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, and Parsi) for generating employment.

name: Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme
brief: The scheme “Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to provide Small Commercial Vehicles and pickups at each CD Block across Meghalaya with 50% financial aid from the Government of Meghalaya.

name: Marketing Assistance Scheme
brief: The "Marketing Assistance Scheme" aims to empower SC leather artisans by enabling them to market their products through Lidkar Leather Emporia under the Lidkar brand. It helps artisans avoid exploitation by private dealers and provides regular procurement of their products based on demand.

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to female workers who are working in a factory/organization in the state of Gujarat after their marriage.

name: Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief: The "Medical Assistance" scheme provides financial assistance to Construction Workers hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or disease. The financial assistance shall be ₹500/- for the first 5 days and ₹50/- each for the remaining days, subject to a maximum of ₹1,5000/-.

name: Medical Aid Scheme (Ayushman Bharat Scheme 'Niramaya') (MPBOCWWB)
brief: The "Medical Aid Scheme (Ayushman Bharat Scheme 'Niramaya')" under the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000/- per year to the registered workers and their families in approved hospitals.

name: Managerial Assistance Scheme for Appointment of Veterinarian
brief: The "Managerial Assistance Scheme for Appointment of Veterinarian" provides financial support to registered Panjrapols for appointing a qualified veterinarian to ensure proper medical care, vaccination, and scientific record-keeping for animals housed in Gaushalas/ Panjrapols.

name: Maternity Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance during pregnancy to women construction workers and construction workers' wives registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board and to provide social stability to construction workers.

name: Maternity Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to female workers and the wives of workers to cover expenses incurred for health check-ups, medicine, nutritious diet, etc., during the maternity period.

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of a registered female worker herself (including one-time remarriage) and for up to two daughters of a registered worker. The scheme applies to the marriage of the female beneficiary herself and the legal, adopted, or stepdaughter of worker.

name: Mukhyamantri Aadharbhut Shiksha Prashikshan Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Aadharbhut Shiksha Prashikshan Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 29 March 2023.

name: Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana" by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand aims to provide quality healthcare services to eligible families. Beneficiaries receive ₹15,00,000/- per family per year as health insurance coverage for advanced medical treatments.

name: Maternity Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief: The "Maternity Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the women employees who are beneficiary of the fund shall be given ₹5,000/- each as maternity benefit.

name: Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries (HPBOCWWB)
brief: The "Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries" scheme under the Labour and Employment Department HP, provides financial support for healthcare. It covers ₹50,000 for outdoor treatment, ₹1,00,000 for indoor treatment, and ₹5,00,000 for critical illnesses each year, upon submission of valid medical bills.

name: Medical Assistance for the Treatment of Critical Illness
brief: Under this scheme, medical assistance of ₹1,00,000/- for the treatment of serious ailments for registered worker and his/her family members. (the benefit can be availed only after 26th July 2014 as the benefit is covered under the Mediclaim & Personal Accident Insurance scheme).

name: Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Persons Marrying Differently Abled Persons
brief: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Persons Marrying Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled couple.

name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Maternal Nutrition
brief: The scheme aims to provide supplementary Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of nutrient-rich food products to pregnant women and lactating mothers across the state.

name: Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons
brief: The 'Maintenance Allowance to Intellectually Disabled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to intellectually disabled persons.

name: Marriage Assistance
brief: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced "Marriage Assistance"  for the employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.

name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons
brief: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled couple.

name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Orthopedically Differently Abled Persons
brief: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Orthopedically Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide marriage assistance to a normal person.

name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons
brief: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide marriage assistance to a normal person marrying a visually Impaired Person.

name: Meghalaya Adventure Tourism Scheme
brief: The objective of the Meghalaya Adventure Tourism Scheme is to promote Meghalaya as a premier eco-adventure destination while generating local livelihoods through sustainable and community-based tourism. It also ensures safety, environmental protection, and sectoral growth.

name: Maintenance Allowance to Severely Affected Persons
brief: The 'Maintenance Allowance to Severely Affected Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance allowance to the severely affected persons who cannot be rehabilitated by any other assistance.

name: Map Approval through UDAY App
brief: It aims to simplify and expedite the process of residential property map creation and approval for all landowners in Haridwar district through mobile app.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana
brief: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

name: Medical Assistance/Wage Compensation during Illness (HBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, wage compensation or financial assistance is provided to registered workers if they are admitted to any government or empanelled private hospital for treatment for a minimum of 4 days and a maximum of 30 days.

name: Meghalaya Agriculture Warehouse Scheme
brief: The scheme reduces post-harvest losses and supports farmers by providing loans and subsidies to build small, weatherproof warehouses for safe storage and better marketing of crops.

name: Mukhyamantri Apprenticeship Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to enhance the employability of Gujarat's youth through apprenticeship training, offering financial incentives to employers, and promoting skill development across various industries.

name: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana (Gujarat Safai Kamdar Development Corporation)
brief: "Mahila Adhikarita Yojana" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, is a centrally sponsored financial support scheme offering loans of ₹20,000/- at a subsidized interest rate to women sweepers and their dependents to promote self-reliance and upliftment.

name: Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna (HPBOCWWB)
brief: The Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna, introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB), provides financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- to registered worker.

name: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana
brief: Under this scheme, loan is provided to woman Safai Karamchari and their dependent daughters for projects with a maximum project cost of up to ₹2,00,000/- for small and petty trade/businesses, and various income-generating activities such as beauty parlors, boutiques, cosmetic shop, bangle shop, etc.

name: Maternity Benefit (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The scheme “Maternity Benefit” was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (A.B.O.C.W.W.B), Labour Welfare Department, Government of Assam for providing financial assistance to the registered women beneficiaries as maternity benefits during the period of maternity.

name: Maternity Benefit (ANBOCWWB)
issuer: Government of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
brief: The scheme offers maternity benefits to female employees registered as beneficiaries for one year during their maternity period. Additionally, male employees, registered for a year, with wives aged 19 or older and not beneficiaries, are also eligible for maternity benefits.

name: Merit Based Award and Recognition Of High Performance In The Board Exams Of SSC And HSSC In The State Of Goa
brief: The objective of this scheme is to motivate students by giving Merit Based Award on the benchmark of performance and to provide financial incentives to high-performing students who are economically weak. The scheme aims to increase the representation of the ST Community in the High-Rank Holders.

name: Mukhyamantree Baal Aasheervaad Yojana
brief: Madhya Pradesh State government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Baal Aashirwad Yojana" for orphan youngsters.

name: Mukhyamantri Bijli Bill Bakaya Maaf Samadhan Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide relief in payment of outstanding electricity bills to the registered workers, construction workers, and BPL consumers under the "Mukhyamantri Mazdoor Kalyan (Sambal) Yojana".

name: Mukhyamantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes
brief: The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. Through this scheme, sheep and goat units are provided free of cost, along with veterinary assistance, to eligible unemployed Scheduled Caste families.

name: Mukhyamantri Bhagyalaxmi Bond Scheme (GBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme has been implemented with the objective of "Beti Bachao Beti Padhao" to prevent female foeticide and to meet the education and marriage expenses of the daughter of a construction worker.

name: Miscarriage Benefit
brief: The "Miscarriage Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial benefits for miscarriage up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

name: Maternity Benefit (CBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be given to the spouse of registered beneficiary woman employee after the delivery of child.

name: Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana
brief: The scheme “Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana” by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh is a Scholarship Scheme for female students belonging to the Balmiki family. The beneficiary receives ₹ 18,000 per annum for college-level studies and professional courses.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojna
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojna" is a government initiative aimed at reducing the gender gap in secondary school enrollment by providing financial assistance to girls for purchasing bicycles, ensuring improved access to education.

name: Maternity Benefit/Delivery Assistance (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Maternity Benefit/Delivery Assistance'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to registered women construction workers for the birth of upto two (2) children.

name: Maternity Benefit For Female Workers- JKBOCWWB
brief: The "Maternity Benefit for Female Workers" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, is a welfare program that provides maternity benefits to eligible registered female workers up to two times in their lifetime.

name: Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries
brief: The "Maternity Benefit for Women Beneficiaries" scheme under the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial assistance to pregnant women registered as beneficiaries and wives of registered beneficiaries. The assistance can be availed up to two times.

name: Maternity Benefit (HPBOCWWB)
brief: The "Maternity Benefit" scheme by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to registered female beneficiaries at the time of delivery or upon the birth of a child.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment, covering 07 identified heart diseases in children. Key features include covering costs for treatment at recognized government or private hospitals.

name: Mukhyamantri Bayan Jyoti Yojana
brief: The Scheme will be implemented "Mukhyarrantri Bayan Jyoti Yojana" (MBJY) under Chief Minister's Special Package for Handloom weavers.

name: Mizoram Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to empower individuals and organizations by providing financial, technical, and institutional support for livelihood, entrepreneurship, and employment generation. It also promotes sustainable socio-economic development and youth engagement in Mizoram.

name: Mukhyamantri Bhavishyalakshi Kaushalya Vikas Yojana
