brief: The scheme aims to develop skills of youth through new age technology-based courses in manufacturing, service and other sectors to create skilled manpower in the state. It provides quality training and certification to Gujarat domicile students.

name: Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to impart basic education, nutrition, and awareness to tribal children aged 6–12. The scheme offers meals, learning material, and other support through community-run centres.

name: Maternity Benefit (MBOCWWB)
brief: Under the scheme, financial assistance in the form of maternity benefits shall be provided to women construction workers registered under the Board during their maternity period.

name: Marriage Benefit (MBOCWWB)
brief: Under the scheme, financial assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers for their own marriage. This assistance shall also be sanctioned for the marriage of all adult children of a worker subject to production of proper documentation such as Marriage Certificates etc.

name: Maternity Benefit (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The “Maternity Benefit” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits to the female beneficiaries subject to a maximum of two children who  are registered beneficiaries for a period of more than one year under the board.

name: Mahila Bakri Palan
brief: The scheme aims to empower women, especially abandoned, widowed, destitute, single, and disaster-affected women, by providing them support for goat rearing to generate livelihood and improve household income.

name: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana
brief: "Madhu Babu Pension Yojana" under the Social Security and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Government Of Odisha is a social welfare scheme designed to provide financial assistance to elderly citizens, widows, and disabled persons who are economically weaker.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Intermediate Pass)
brief: The Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana is a scheme by the Bihar government aimed at promoting girl child education, curbing child marriages, reducing fertility rates, and empowering girls to become self-reliant.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Matriculation)
brief: The scheme provides a financial incentive to girls who achieve a first division in their matriculation examination.

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to improve the health of pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) by providing nutritious food, including eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

name: Mhaji Bus Scheme
brief: The scheme provides a subsidy of ₹3/- per kilometer operated, 50% reimbursement of the annual insurance premium paid up to a maximum of ₹30,000/-, and assistance of ₹10,00,000/- for replacing buses older than 15 years with new buses having a minimum seating capacity of 27.

name: Maternity Benefit Scheme (HBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme “Maternity Benefit Scheme (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

name: Maternity Benefit Scheme - Telangana
brief: The "Maternity Benefit Scheme" was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Department, Telangana. The scheme provides financial assistance to registered women workers, as well as the wives & daughters of registered workers to support them.

name: Maternity Benefit Scheme (APB&OCWWB)
brief: The Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh has proposed and implemented the scheme “Maternity Benefit Scheme” for Registered Workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

name: Maternity Benefit Scheme (APBOCWWB)
brief: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers have introduced the "Maternity Benefit Scheme" to registered construction workers. The scheme aims to support registered women workers, wives of registered male workers, & their daughters during maternity, reducing the financial strain.

name: Maternity Benefits Scheme (BBOCWWB)
brief: "Maternity Benefits Scheme" provides an amount equivalent to 90 days of the minimum wages set by the State Govt. for unskilled workers at the time of childbirth. The applicant should be a female construction worker who has completed one year of membership with the Board.

name: Maternity Benefit Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Maternity Benefit Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the female construction workers and spouse of the male workers to support childbirth-related expenses maximum for two living children.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girls in Bihar by providing a one-time incentive of ₹25,000/- to eligible graduate students of the state.

name: Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students
brief: "Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students" by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa aims to motivate students by providing merit-based awards and financial incentives (ranging from ₹5,000/- to ₹20,000/-) to high-performing students who are economically weak.

name: Maternity Financial Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support to registered women construction workers during the maternity period. This assistance is admissible only for the birth of up to two children.

name: Maternity Benefit to the Female Beneficiary
brief: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board (MBOCWWB) provide "Maternity Benefit" to female workers registered under the Act. Financial assistance is provided in cases of miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy, up to two times.

name: Mai Bhago Vidya Scheme
brief: Under this scheme, the goal is to support girls from economically weaker families by providing assistance for transportation, enabling regular school attendance.

name: Maternity Benefit
brief: The "Maternity Benefit'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides maternity benefits up to two times in a lifetime to the eligible female beneficiaries or the wives of male beneficiaries.

name: Magnifiers - Tamil Nadu
brief: The Department launched the "Magnifiers by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department" scheme for differently-abled persons. Under this scheme, magnifiers are distributed to needy students with low vision to enable them to read books.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana
brief: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across all districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
brief: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across all districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

name: Makhana Beej Vitaran
brief: The scheme aims to boost farmers' income by improving the production and productivity of Makhana in 11 districts of Bihar through the distribution of high-quality seeds at subsidized rates.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Dragon Fruit Vikas Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to expand dragon fruit cultivation in 21 districts of the state, providing financial assistance to ryot farmers for establishing and maintaining dragon fruit plantations.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Kela Vikas Yojana
brief: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across 15 districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Papita Vikas Yojana
brief: The Scheme aims to expand plantain cultivation across all districts in Bihar. Farmers can receive subsidies for up to 10 acres and access high-quality tissue-cultured plants for cultivation.

name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Strawberry Vikas Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to promote strawberry cultivation across 20 districts in Bihar. It provides subsidies on seedlings, packaging materials, and equipment to support farmers in enhancing strawberry production.

name: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
brief: “Medical Camps (Allopathy and Indian systems of Medicine)" under the umbrella scheme "Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged" was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The senior citizens are provided free health checkups and free medicines.

name: Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana
brief: The Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana scheme for children who have lost their parent(s) to the COVID pandemic, the government will provide these children funding for good education and health.

name: Medhavi Chhatr/Chhatra Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Medhavi Chhatr/ Chhatra Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" for education.

name: Micro Credit Finance
brief: Under the Micro Credit Finance Scheme, beneficiaries from the Charmkar Community receive financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 at an interest rate of 5% per annum. This assistance includes a subsidy of ₹10,000, with the remaining amount provided as a loan.

name: Micro Credit Finance (NSFDC)
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The scheme is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Under this scheme, loans are provided to individuals from the SC community for units costing up to ₹1,40,000/- for income-generating activities.

name: Micro Credit Finance under NSKFDC- Haryana
brief: Under this scheme, loan is provided to Safai Karamchari and their dependents for projects with a maximum cost up to ₹1,00,000/- per beneficiaries for small and petty trade/business and various income generating activities.

name: Mass Communication Internship Programme
brief: The Mass Communication Internship Programme by the Department of Water Resources, River Development, and Ganga Rejuvenation. The intern program will offer work culture and environment knowledge about the functioning of the Government and its departments in information, education, and communication.

name: Merit Cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme
brief: It is the policy of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi that students get access to high quality higher education provided by Delhi State Universities irrespective of their caste, creed, economic background, or gender.

name: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
brief: "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized Polytechnic Institutions in Chhattisgarh.

name: Merit·cum·Means Scholarships For Under Graduate Studies In Various Branches Of Agriculture And Animal Science Subjects
issuer: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
brief: The scheme of "Merit·cum·Means Scholarships For Under Graduate Studies In Various Branches Of Agriculture And Animal Science Subjects" was introduced by ICAR with a view to attracting meritorious undergraduate students to prosecute their studies up to graduation level.

name: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University
brief: "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹1,000/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized engineering universities in Chhattisgarh.

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana
brief: The state government has announced the implementation of 'Universal Health Coverage' in the state in the budget announcement 2021-22, in compliance of which Chief Minister Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme was started in the state from May 1, 2021.

name: Meghalaya Cinema Theatre Scheme
brief: The scheme's objective is to promote youth entrepreneurship and employment in Meghalaya by supporting cinema theatres while preserving the state’s cultural heritage.

name: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxis, thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.

name: Medical Check-Up facility (UKBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme aims to provide medical check-up facilities to registered construction workers through door-to-door visits, health camps, and collection centers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.

name: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to support eligible NCC cadets through financial incentives to encourage continued participation in education and NCC training. Under this scheme, scholarship amounts ranging from ₹600/- to ₹2,400/- are provided annually to eligible NCC cadets at group and unit levels.

name: Market Development Assistance
brief: The scheme aims to promote organic fertilizers produced at Bio-Gas and Compressed Bio-Gas plants under the Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan initiative. It provides Market Development Assistance of ₹1,500/- per Metric Tonne to manufacturing and marketing entities of organic fertilizers.

name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Animal Distribution Programme (Special Backward Tribes Baiga, Bharia & Sahariya)
brief: The scheme aims to improve the livelihood and nutritional security of tribal communities by providing two dairy animals at a 90% subsidy to eligible tribal livestock farmers.

name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat
brief: The scheme "Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat" under the "Market Development Assistance to MSMEs" aims to provide financial assistance to organizers of industrial exhibitions in Gujarat.

name: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)
brief: The scheme "Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)" under the "Market Development Assistance to MSMEs" aims to offer reimbursement for stall rent, product literature, and display materials to MSMEs participating in exhibitions.

name: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme
brief: The Marketing Development Assistance (MDA) Scheme under the Overseas Promotion & Publicity (OPP) Scheme aims to support the promotion and marketing of Indian tourism in overseas markets.

name: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
brief: The scheme "Marathi Drama Competition 'A' & 'B' Group" is a state-level initiative by the Kala Academy, under the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. It provides a platform to urban and rural theatre groups and offers transport assistance for artistes and stage material as per govt.

name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
brief: The objectives of the scheme is to increase food grain production in order to attain self-sufficiency by growing high yielding varieties of maize and also by adopting the crop and location specific production technology.

name: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award
brief: Named after the hockey wizard Major Dhyan Chand (1905–79), an Indian legendary field hockey player, "Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award" is the highest sporting honour of India. Instituted in 1991–1992, the award is conferred annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.

name: Mahila Dairy Vikas Pariyojana - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to empower rural women in Uttarakhand by promoting their active participation in the dairy sector through Women Milk Producers Cooperative Societies, enhancing milk production, and providing training, incentives, and awareness programs for sustainable livelihood development.

name: Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme
brief: The Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program includes Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme under the Planning Dept, Govt of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to employ, engage, and empower the youth and rural communities by promoting Dairy related entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.

name: Digital India Internship Scheme
issuer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
brief: An opportunity for a student to secure practical work experience under the guidance of a qualified and experienced Supervisor/Mentor in Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) in the form of Digital India Internship Scheme.

name: Mid Day Meals Scheme
brief: The Mid Day Meals Scheme is a government initiative that provides free meals to school children to improve their nutritional status and encourage school attendance.

name: Madhyamik Drop-out Coaching
brief: The scheme aims to provide intensive coaching to Madhyamik dropout students and prepare them for the Madhyamik Examination. Through this scheme, coaching, honorarium for teaching staff, and stipends for candidates are provided to Madhyamik failed Scheduled Tribe (ST) students.

name: Millet Development Scheme
brief: The "Millet Development Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat, aims to promote millet cultivation in Gujarat by organizing promotional activities, expos, processing units, demonstrations(seed/input kit ), and taluka-level melas.

name: "Market Development Support Assistance" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives"
brief: Through "Market Development Support Assistance", assistance worth 50% of total rent, literature and display material (subject to a max. of ₹5,00,000/-) is provided to the industrial unit for participation in international trade fair as an industry association. The applications are accepted offline.

name: Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Chhatra Yojana
brief: "Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Chhatra Yojana" aims to provide comprehensive support to the disabled community in Bihar. A significant component of this scheme involves the distribution of battery-operated tricycles to beneficiaries to enhance their mobility and independence.

name: Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide social security to the disabled women/men of the state by encouraging their marriage and providing them financial assistance. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.

name: Mukhyamantri Ekeekrit Bagwani Vikas Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to promote horticulture development in Uttarakhand by providing farmers with subsidized fruit plants, seeds, pesticides, & horticulture infrastructure such as Cool Houses & Refrigerator Vans, thereby increasing productivity, reducing post-harvest losses, & enhancing farmers’ income.

name: Motivation of Entrepreneurs and Financial Assistance for Rehabilitation of Sick Industries
brief: Through this scheme, the cost of implementing suggestions given by the experts in the field of technology, marketing and finance engaged to advise sick units is reimbursed. 50% subsidy towards the cost of diagnostic study by technical institutions initiated through Financial Institutions/Banks/etc.

name: Migrants Employment Generation Programme
brief: The Government of Tamil Nadu has launched the “Migrants Employment Generation Programme (MEGP)” for the Non-Resident Tamils, who returned back to Tamil Nadu due to Covid-19 Pandemic.

name: Modular Employable Skills
brief: The SDIS is a government initiative for improving employability through vocational training. It's a partnership between government and industry to provide skills development programs for early school dropouts and workers in unorganized sector.

name: Matritva, Shishu Evam Baalika Madad Yojana
brief: "Maatrtv, Shishu Evan Baalika Madad Yojana" is a initiative of Uttar Pradesh state Government to provide the financial assistance to the mother and her girl child.

name: Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The “Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for the treatment of beneficiary or his/ her dependents suffering from major diseases.

name: Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery
brief: "Medical Expenses-Treatment for Major Ailments Including Surgery'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dept.,West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides medical expenses for the treatment of beneficiary or his/ her dependents suffering from Cancer, Heart disease, Kidney disease, T.B. etc.

name: Medical Expenses for Treatment of Major Ailments of a Beneficiary
brief: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board provides financial support for the treatment of serious illnesses such as Tuberculosis, Cancer, Heart Disease, Kidney Disease, and more, for building workers and their family members.

name: Modular Functional Artificial Limbs
brief: The 'Modular Functional Artificial Limbs' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, modular functional artificial limbs are provided for orthopedically differently-abled students, employed or self-employed.

name: Mobile Food Court Van (DAADC)
brief: The scheme aims to generate self-employment opportunities in the food and beverage sector by providing credit to unemployed scheduled caste individuals belonging to Antyodaya families. Under this scheme, loans are provided to the eligible beneficiaries at a concessional interest rate.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 8 Ton/Day
brief: The scheme aims to promote fish feed self-sufficiency and affordability among fish farmers. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for setting up medium-sized fish feed mills with a production capacity of 8 tons per day, benefiting entrepreneurs and fish farmers.

name: Micro Finance (GBCDC)
brief: The scheme aims to create self-employment for the backwards class men. Through this scheme, low interest rates and financial help are provided to the backwards class men.

name: Micro Finance Scheme (GNDTDC)
brief: The scheme promotes self-employment among Nomadic and Denotified Tribes by offering loan up to ₹1,25,000 at a concessional interest rate to help start small-scale businesses or enterprises.

name: Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)
brief: The scheme "Mission for Integrated Horticulture Development (MIDH)" is a centrally sponsored scheme that aims to promote growth in the horticulture sector through financial and technical support to farmers for cultivation, post-harvest management, and market linkage development.

name: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹25,000/- to the freedom fighters of Uttarakhand and to the widows of deceased freedom fighters, in recognition of their contribution to the nation.

name: Micro Finance Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under the scheme, small loans of ₹1,00,000/- are provided to members of SHGs, either directly or through the SHGs, to meet the needs of the poorest among the poor.

name: Micro Finance Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes &d Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under the scheme, small loans of ₹1,50,000/- per beneficiary are provided to members of Self-Help Groups (SHGs), either directly or through the SHGs.

name: Micro Finance Scheme of NMDFC
brief: Under the scheme, an amount of Rs. 1 lakh under credit Line-1 & upto  Rs. 1.5 lakh under Credit Line-2 is extended to each member of SHG (belong to Minority communities) at interest rate of 7% & 10% respectively.  Concession of 2% is extended to women beneficiaries under Credit Line-2.

name: Microcredit Finance Scheme- Self Help Groups (DAADC)
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment for SC individuals. It offers microloans to start small businesses and become economically self-sufficient.

name: Micro Finance Scheme for Self Help Groups (GTKVN)
brief: The scheme aims to economically empower women from Thakor and Koli castes through self-employment opportunities via Self Help Groups (SHGs). Under this scheme, eligible members of SHGs receive a loan up to ₹60,000/- at low interest to start or expand small-scale businesses/enterprises.

name: Small Business (GBCDC)
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance at a low interest rate to SEBC individuals for small business ventures.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Yojana
brief: This scheme aims to provide safe housing for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Extremely Backward Classes whose existing group housing under previous schemes has become broken down.

name: Mahatama Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana
brief: The Scheme “Mahatama Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana” was launched during 2005-06 by Handlooms, Textiles & Handicrafts Dept. of Govt. of Odisha to provide enhanced insurance cover to the handloom weavers in the case of natural as well as accidental death and in cases of total or partial disability.

name: Maintenance of Govt Boys and Girls Hostels (SC)
brief: Under this scheme, it provides free hostel, food, and academic facilities to scheduled caste students pursuing post-SSC education.

name: Marriage Grant of Rs.51,000/- to Daughter/Sister of Personnel Killed/ Disabled in War/ Action/Terrorist Attack/Naxalite Attack/IS Duty
brief: The scheme provides ₹51,000 as a wedding gift to the sister or daughter of a martyred soldier to honor their sacrifice and support the dependent family.

name: Meghalaya Goat Farming Scheme
brief: The Meghalaya Goat Farming Development Scheme is a component of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program, launched by the Govt of Meghalaya. It aims to employ, engage, and empower youth and rural communities by promoting goat farming entrepreneurship, providing easy access to credit and subsidies.

name: Mizoram Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations and Individuals
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to voluntary organizations and individuals to support welfare activities for disadvantaged and marginalized groups such as women, children, disabled persons, elderly, and socially vulnerable individuals.

name: Maintenance Grant to Institutions and Organizations Engaged in Cultural Activities
brief: The "Maintenance Grant to Institutions and Organizations Engaged in Cultural Activities" scheme was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide a maintenance grant to the organizations engaged in cultural activities.

name: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme
brief: The "Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme" provides financial assistance to deserving Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, and Backward Class students for pursuing postgraduate education in top-ranked universities abroad.

name: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of the Daughter of War Disabled Ex-Servicemen above 50% Disability
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- is provided for the marriage of each dependent daughter of war-disabled ex-servicemen whose disability has been assessed above 50%, for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.

name: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows of Ex-servicemen (other than War Widows)
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹11,000/- is provided to the widows of ex-servicemen (other than war widows) for the marriage of their daughters, for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
brief: An employment scheme by the MoRD, providing provide at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work. Any Indian citizen above the age of 18 years and residing in a rural area can apply to this scheme.

name: Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹51,000 is provided for the marriage of each dependent orphan daughter of an ex-serviceman, for up to two daughters, who are at least 18 years old.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide pure drinking water through pipelines to every rural household in Bihar. This initiative started in 2016 with a focus on community involvement, local governance, and sustainable water management.

name: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
brief: The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

name: Mukhyamantri Gram Parivahan Yojana
brief: The Scheme provides financial assistance for purchasing vehicles to enhance transportation facilities in rural areas. It includes grants for regular vehicles, e-rickshaws, and ambulances under specified conditions.

name: Marriage Grant Scheme
brief: In Uttar Pradesh State, a scheme for the marriage of girls from economically weaker families of the state.

name: Matching Grant Scheme
brief: Under the “Matching Grant Scheme”, the Start-ups that raise funds from a registered/recognized funding source prior to the product launch phase will be provided 25% of the matching funds or a maximum benefit of ₹ 25,00,000, at proportionate ownership of stock, subsequent to due diligence by the SPC.

name: Marriage Gift Scheme - Telangana
brief: The "Marriage Gift Scheme" was launched by the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, LET&F (Labour) Dept. Telangana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance as a marriage gift to unmarried registered women workers & the daughters of registered building & construction

name: Marriage Gift Scheme (APBOCWWB)
brief: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers have introduced the "Marriage Gift Scheme" for registered unmarried women workers & the two daughters of registered construction workers. This welfare initiative aims to provide financial assistance on the occasion of their marriage

name: Museum Grant Scheme
brief: Under this scheme provide financial support for establishing new museums, upgrading and modernizing existing ones, promoting digitization of collections, and enhancing the skills of museum professionals across regional, state, and district levels.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Street Vendor Rin Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide working capital or low-cost equipment as a loan through banks to support businesses. It benefits poor-class migrant workers and small traders (Street Vendors) in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh, also offering necessary Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training.

name: "Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension)" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme
brief: "Monthly Grant To Old Crafts Persons (Pension)” by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Union Territory of Puducherry, aims to provide pensions to artisans in their old age, recognizing their contribution to traditional crafts. Eligible craftspersons receive a monthly grant of ₹2,000/-.

name: Marriage Grant to War Widows’ Daughters of Ex-Servicemen
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹21,000/- is provided to the war widows for marriage of their dependent daughters, for up to two daughters who are at least 18 years old.

name: Manav Garima Yojana
brief: The scheme offers financial assistance to Scheduled Caste individuals who wish to establish cottage industries for self-employment without requiring bank loans. Employment/tool kits are provided to those who seek self-employment opportunities.

name: Maintenance of Horti Hubs
brief: The objective of the scheme is to procure good quality disease-free and commercially accepted varieties of the identified flowers and multiply and, to serve as a demonstration cum training ground for those who are interested in Floriculture and who intend to make this as their means of livelihood.

name: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Higher Education/Technical Education
brief: Under this scheme, the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls enrolled under the Palanhar Scheme to pursue higher or technical education, based on their qualifications and interest in employment-oriented courses.

name: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Professional/Technical Training
brief: Under this scheme, vocational/technical training is provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys & girls through recognized training providers such as the Rajasthan Skill & Livelihood Development Corporation, Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Ltd., it is etc. recognized by the State or Central Govt.

name: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Self-Employment/Business
brief: Under this scheme, eligible boys and girls receive financial assistance in two installments - 60% initially and 40% later, to establish self-employment or business ventures. The support is specifically linked to the training course completed by the beneficiary.

name: "Marketing Incentive" under the "Handloom Marketing Assistance" Component of the National Handloom Development Programme
brief: The scheme aims to develop and promote marketing channels for handloom products to bring greater visibility to the sector and ensure commensurate remuneration to weavers. It provides Marketing Incentive to eligible handloom agencies for creating conducive conditions for marketing handloom products.

name: Matrimonial Incentives
brief: In this scheme, if a Person with Disability (PwD) gets married to a non-disabled person, then the couple is provided a marriage incentive of up to ₹ 50,000. Only citizens who are permanent residents of the state of Maharashtra are eligible to apply for this scheme.

name: Mission on Integrated Development of Horticulture- NHM and HMNEH
issuer: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
brief: The scheme aims to promote the holistic growth of the horticulture sector through production enhancement, productivity improvement, post-harvest management, processing, marketing support, skill development, and infrastructure creation for horticulture crops while augmenting farmers’ income.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture Sub Scheme Horticulture Mission for North East and Himalayan Region- Meghalaya
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to promote holistic growth of Horticulture sector thorough promotion, extension, post-harvest management, processing and marketing.

name: MANAGE Internship Programme
issuer: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
brief: MANAGE Internship Programme is open to students from the disciplines of Extension Education, Economics, Sociology, Psychology, MSW, Journalism, Communication, and Environmental Science. The internships are open year-round, and the duration ranges from 3 months upto 6 months.

name: Marriage Incentive Reward Scheme
brief: The Marriage Incentive Reward scheme for the marriage of disabled persons by the Government of Uttar Pradesh is being operated by the department since the year 1997.

name: Matru Jyothi - Financial Assistance For PwD Mothers
brief: The scheme “Matru Jyothi - Financial Assistance for PwD Mothers” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
brief: The Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana, launched by the Government of Maharashtra, offers cashless treatment for identified diseases through a network of government and private healthcare providers.

name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Mandi shramik kalyaan yojana
brief: The Agriculture Department of Rajasthan runs the Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Mandi Shramik Kalyan Yojana, a program that offers a range of assistance programs to improve the well-being of mandi laborers.

name: Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi for BC and EBC Students
brief: The scheme “Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi” was launched by the Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Telangana for meritorious students belonging to Backward Classes & Economically Backward Classes to pursue Higher Studies in foreign universities.

name: Mukhyamantri Jankalyan (Shiksha Protsahan Yojna)
brief: This scheme has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Through the Mukhyamantri Jankalyan Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, financial assistance will be provided for education to students of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Mukh‍yamantri Janakal‍yaan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Asangathit Karmakaar Man‍da)
brief: The Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana is a initiative of Madhya Pradesh government. The scheme will provide much-needed social security to unorganized workers in the state and help them live a dignified life.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme
brief: The Government of Madhya Pradesh has launched a scheme entitled “Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana” on 01 April 201,  for the welfare of citizens having one daughter.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhavak Pension Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support to parents or couples who have only daughters. The scheme provides a recurring monthly pension amount of ₹500/- (Rupees 500) to the eligible recipient or couple. The applicant must be a resident of the state of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Mukhyamantri Konya Atmonirbhor Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide a free Scooty to the meritorious girl students, which will be useful for them to travel to their College.

name: Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana
brief: This scheme "Mrityu ki Dasha Mein Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana"  started by the Labor department of Madhya Pradesh to provide the financial assistance in the case of death.

name: Mukhyamantri Kalyakani Pension  Yojana
brief: Under the Scheme, Every month financial assistance is provided to the Kalyani (widow) residing in the state for providing social security and subsistence.

name: Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Mitra Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to create necessary infrastructure by the distribution company for providing permanent pump connections to farmers or groups of farmers.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
brief: The scheme was launched on September 6, 2019, to provide relief and support to farmers in case of crop damage due to natural calamities and was implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Kanya Suraksha Yojana (MKSY)" is a welfare initiative by the Government of Bihar to combat female foeticide, improve the sex ratio, and promote birth registration.

name: Mukhyamantri Kishori Swasthya Yojna
brief: This initiative by the State Government aimed at reducing school dropout rates among adolescent girls by providing free sanitary napkins, promoting hygiene, and supporting their overall health.

name: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana
brief: Mukhyamantri Kalakar Sahayata Yojana is a scheme under the Odia Language, Literature & Culture Department, Government of Odisha aims to offer sustenance and assistance to elderly artists who, despite facing financial hardship, have consistently devoted themselves to enriching culture of the state.

name: Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the state, enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana
brief: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana” was launched by Dept. of Agriculture, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh by merging 3 ongoing protection-based Departmental schemes namely Sour Badhbandi, Anti-Hail Net Structure & Green House Renovation into single scheme having a common objective.

name: Mukhya mantri Krishak Udyami Yojana
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the sons and daughters of farmers to establish their businesses. the government of Madhya Pradesh provided loans to the bank for all citizens of the state.

name: Mushroom Kit Vitaran
brief: The scheme aims to provide subsidized mushroom kits and training to farmers, promoting mushroom cultivation as a sustainable livelihood opportunity.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana
brief: The purpose of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to poor families at the time of marriage, to encourage girls' education, and prevent child marriage.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah / Nikaah Yojana
brief: In 2006, Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah Yojana" for females/girls.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana
brief: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana launched by Social Justice and empowerment in 2015 by Rajasthan for Family provides financial support to eligible families to help them cover the expenses associated with their daughters' weddings.

name: Manav Kalyan Yojana
brief: The scheme provides toolkit assistance (e-vouchers) to economically weak individuals (annual income ≤ ₹6,00,000/-) for self-employment in 10 trades like dairy, plumbing, and beauty parlors. Beneficiaries include SC/ST, nomadic tribes, and BPL families.

name: Mahila Kisan Yojana
brief: The scheme "Mahila Kisan Yojana" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Government of Haryana. Through this scheme, loans are provided to the women from Scheduled Castes for the betterment of their economic status through self-employment.

name: Mahila Kisan Yojana (Maharashtra)
brief: "Mahila Kisan Yojana" is implemented by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to uplift the lifestyle of economically disadvantaged Charmakar communities. it supports the production and sale of various types of footwear and leather articles.

name: Mobile Learning Centre (UKBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme aims to provide education to the children of registered construction workers at construction sites through Mobile Learning Centre buses, ensuring their better and brighter future.

name: Mumkin - Livelihood Generation Scheme
brief: "Mumkin - Livelihood Generation Scheme" is a initiative of Jammu & Kashmir State. This scheme is provide the financial help to the youth to empower them and promote the self employment.

name: Merit Loan Scheme for Good Borrowers
brief: The scheme aims to assist the units of PIPDIC whose loan accounts are classified as Standard Assets continuously for 3 years. The assistance is provided for construction of additional building, purchase of additional machineries & equipments essential for expansion /modernisation / diversification.

name: Mobile Lab Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Mobile Lab Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides reimbursement of expenditure incurred by the beneficiaries and their dependents for the treatment of silicosis.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Chhatravas Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, students belonging to minority communities who are studying in a recognized institution, school, college, university, or technical institution in their respective districts and residing in minority hostels are provided a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/-.

name: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Ewam Anusuchit Janjati Civil Sewa Protsahan Yojana
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to SC & ST candidates who qualify in the preliminary examination of Civil Services Competitive Examination conducted by the BPSC, Patna, and the UPSC, New Delhi, to support their preparation for main examination/interview.

name: Mukhya Mantri Agricultural Mechanization Scheme
brief: The "Mukhya Mantri Agricultural Mechanization Scheme" launched by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, offers financial assistance ranging from ₹1,200/- to ₹11,00,000/- to farmers in Gujarat for purchasing agricultural machinery and farm equipment.

name: Chief Minister EBC Civil Seva Protsahan Yojana
brief: The Bihar Government provides incentives to individuals belonging to the EBC Categories upon passing the preliminary examination of various competitive exams such as UPSC, BPSC, NDA, CDS, Banking, Railway, SSC, etc., to support their further preparation for the main examination/interview.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana
brief: The scheme supports minority community candidates of Uttarakhand by offering financial incentives for competitive exam preparation. Incentives are provided at different stages of success in exams like UPSC, UKPSC (including judicial services), and entrances to IITs & IIMs.

name: Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna
brief: The "Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna" is a government initiative launched to encourage the enrollment and retention of girl students in schools by providing them with school uniforms.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure first, second, or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.

name: Modified Market Development Assistance Scheme
issuer: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief: The scheme aims to enhance the production and sales of Khadi and Polyvastra products by supporting technology upgradation, market promotion, and providing direct incentives to artisans and Karyakartas. It targets Khadi Institutions and their associated artisans and workers.

name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Plus Programme (Provision of 02 Murrah Buffaloes on Subsidy)
brief: The scheme aims to increase milk production and promote improved livestock breeding by providing two Murrah buffaloes to eligible farmers on a subsidy basis.

name: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat
brief: Mukhya Mantrir Eti koli duti paat also referred to as the Assam Tea Garden Workers' Financial Assistance Scheme 2025. This initiative marks the 200th-year celebration of Assam Tea and aims to provide one-time financial assistance to tea garden workers in recognition of their invaluable contribution.

name: Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal
brief: The scheme aims to form groups of interested women and men from Gram Panchayats across the state, who are 18 years of age or above, enabling them to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake business or livelihood activities.

name: Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious packed silage and total mixed animal feed to livestock farmers, especially women, in the remote hilly areas of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, silage is made available to livestock farmers at a subsidized rate of ₹2.75 per kg.

name: Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana
brief: This scheme introduced by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support meritorious students by providing scholarships from Class 6th to Class 12th in selected schools.

name: Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojana
brief: The objective of launching the Mukhya Mantri Grihini Suvidha Yojna was to provide free gas connections to those families who were not covered under the Centre's Ujjwala scheme.

name: Mukhya Mantri Gyandeep Yojna
brief: A scheme to provide financial support in the form of interest subsidy on Educational Loans availed from Banks by Himachali Students for pursuing Higher Education in India and Abroad.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan-Van Scheme
brief: The Mukhyamantri Jan-Van Scheme aims to promote tree plantation on private lands in Jharkhand to enhance farmers' income, conserve the environment, and reduce pressure on notified forests. Farmers are encouraged to plant trees on their lands with incentives covering 75% of plantation and maintenance

name: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Sa Sajuli Yozana - Assam
brief: The scheme “Mukhya Mantri Krishi Sa Sajuli Yojana” is a State Owned Priority Development (SOPD) scheme for farmers launched by the Assam government in FY 2018-19.  The main purpose of launching this scheme for farmers is their holistic development by implementing several farm mechanization schemes.

name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana (MMKSY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women farmers in the state. The scheme was announced in the 2018-19 budget and is being implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Co-operation.

name: Mukhya Mantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to incentivize farmers for improving production and quality of specific Rabi and Kharif crops by providing an incentive payment over and above the Minimum Support Price received. It provides varying financial incentives per quintal to registered farmers selling wheat, paddy, etc.

name: Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widowed women during remarriage. It offers a one-time support of ₹2,00,000 to eligible kalyani beneficiaries.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
brief: The scheme was started by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh in 2006. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the mass marriage of girls, widows, and abandoned women from destitute or poor families in the state.

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanyadaan Yojana
brief: Under Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana, the daughters of below poverty line families or widows or destitute or family earning less than Rs. 35000-/ year are given finacial help for their marriage by Government of Himachal Pradesh.

name: MMKY-Financial Assistance for New Boat, Engine, and Net
brief: The State plan scheme “MMKY-Financial Assistance for New Boat, Engine, and Net” was launched by the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development Department, Government of Odisha in order to increase the marine fish production and to enhance incomes and livelihoods of the marine fishers.

name: "Input Assistance to Farmers for Taking up Fish Farming in Farm Ponds" Component of the "Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana" Scheme
brief: The objective of this scheme is to increase the inland fish production, and to enhance the income of farmers in the State though aquaculture. Input assistance is provided to the farmers who have excavated farm ponds under MGNREGA for facilitating the production of fingerling and fish.

name: MMKY-New Tank Excavation Under Brackish Water Aquaculture
brief: The State plan scheme “MMKY-New Tank Excavation Under Brackish Water Aquaculture” was launched by the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development Department, Government of to promote farmers and entrepreneurs to take up Brackish water aquaculture.

name: "Reactivation Of Fisheries Cooperative Societies" Component of the "Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana" Scheme
brief: The objective of the "Reactivation Of Fisheries Cooperative Societies" scheme is to provide a one-time revolving fund of ₹2,00,000/- to each eligible Primary Fishermen Cooperative Society for working capital of the society and improvement of the socio-economic status of the members in the long run.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.

name: Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana" is for the economic freedom of women in the state age group of 21 to 65, improving their health and nutrition and strengthening their decisive role in the family. The women will receive a financial benefit through direct benefit transfer.

name: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Medhwi Balika Protsahan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities based on their performance in the High School Examination or its equivalent (Munshi/Maulvi) and Intermediate Examination or its equivalent (Alim).

name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Nirman Shramik Sammaan Yojana (HBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, registered female workers, who have minimum one-year’s regular membership, are being provided financial assistance of ₹5100/- for the purchase of Saree, Suit, Slippers, Raincoat, Umbrella, Sanitary Napkin and Kitchen utensil etc.

name: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, permanent training will be provided for the economic and social upliftment of women suffering from any form of violence and living in difficult circumstances so that they can get employment.

name: Mukhya Mantri Matritva Sahayata Yojana
brief: The scheme "Mukhya Mantri Matritva Sahayata Yojana" by the Women and Child Development Department, Haryana, aims to provide a cash incentive of ₹5,000/- during maternity to eligible pregnant and lactating women on the birth of a second child (boy).

name: Mukhyamantri Madad Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, a Scheduled Tribe family receives 50kg of wheat or rice and cooking utensils from the Panchayat upon the birth of a child. In the event of a family member's death, the family is provided with 1 quintal of wheat or rice.

name: Mukhya Mantrir Nijut Moina Aasoni
brief: The scheme aims to support ten lakh girl students with financial grants as admission incentives for Higher Secondary, Graduation, and Post-Graduation studies to eradicate child marriage. It benefits unmarried girl students domiciled in Assam with monthly financial assistance.

name: Mukhyamantri Nikah Yojana
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the needy girls, widows, and abandoned women from destitute or poor Muslim families in the state at the time of their marriage (In case of mass marriage).

name: Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana
brief: "Mukhyamantri Prakhand Parivahan Yojana" to provide transportation facilities connecting blocks & remote Panchayats with district headquarters. This scheme aims to encourage scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, backward classes entrepreneurship by providing financial support to purchase buses.

name: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to improve employability through free skill training for youth of backward and extremely backward communities.

name: Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna
brief: The scheme “Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna” was launched by Dept. of Higher Education, H.P. during the year 2013-14. Under the scheme, an Incentive/Award will be given to students of the State who are selected and take admission for a degree course in any IIT/AIIMS/IIM/ISM Dhanbad/IISc Bangalore.

name: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana Jharkhand
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana" by the Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to unemployed candidates who have completed skill training programs aligned with NSQF.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women by providing nutritional food such as eggs twice a week and dates twice a week at Anganwadi Centres.

name: Mukhyamatri Rojgaar Srijan Yojana
brief: The Mukhyamantri Rojgaar Srijan Yojana aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among Scheduled Tribes (ST), Scheduled Castes (SC), Minorities, Backward Classes, and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) by providing subsidized loans and financial assistance.

name: Meghalaya Motorcaravan Scheme
brief: The scheme promotes alternative tourism and supports rural and eco-tourism in the state. It encourages entrepreneurship by providing financial assistance for operating motorcaravans and aims to create employment opportunities while offering unique travel experiences across Meghalaya.

name: Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna
brief: The “Mukhya Mantri Shahri Ajeevika Guarantee Yojna” was launched by the Department of Urban Development, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to enhance livelihood security in urban areas by providing 120 days of guaranteed wage employment to every household in a financial year.

name: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana for Students of Economically Weaker Section
brief: Under the scheme, a cash award of ₹50,000 will be given to students studying in government schools affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer, who secure the highest marks in the EWS category in the Class 10th and Class 12th examinations (Arts, Commerce, and Science streams).

name: Mukhmantri Sehat Bima Yojana
brief: "AYUSHMAN BHARAT PM-JAY MUKH MANTRI SEHAT BIMA YOJNA” is a flagship State Health Insurance Program of the Government of Punjab.

name: Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Samekit Chaur Vikas Yojana" under Seven Nishchay-2, aims to develop undeveloped and unutilized private land in Bihar for fish-based integrated aquaculture. With a budget of ₹2972.79 lakh, the scheme targets the sustainable development of 600 hectares of Chaur land, enhancing fish.

name: Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students
brief: The "Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students" scheme was launched by the Department of Higher & Technical Education, Govt. of Jharkhand. This scholarship program aims to make the girl students aware of enrollment in technical education, making them self-reliant & providing financial assistance.

name: Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao Yojana
brief: The Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao Yojana provides On-the-Job Training (OJT) to educated youth in registered industries and businesses. Annually, 1 lakh youth will benefit, with a stipend of up to ₹1 lakh funded by the state government.

name: Mukhya Mantri Shramyogi Prathibhavan Vidyarthi Yojana (HBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance for books, stationery, hostels, and laptops/computers for higher education to the meritorious children of registered construction workers.

name: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" by the Directorate of Higher Education, Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide free coaching and financial assistance to students prepare for national level competitive examinations like JEE, NEET, CLAT, NHMC

name: Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
brief: Launched on 1st April 2018, the scheme "Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" by the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides maternity support to pregnant women over 18 years of age who are registered as unorganized workers.

name: Mukhyamantri Shramshakti Yojana
brief: This scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to men and women aged 18 to 45 from the minority community by offering vocational skill training in various fields or by providing loans through the Bihar State Minority Financial Corporation, Patna, for self-employment.

name: Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,00,000/- will be provided to the widows/dependents of workers employed in industrial and commercial institutions in Haryana, in the event of the worker's death while working at the workplace.

name: Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
brief: Under the scheme, the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹5 lakhs to the nominee or legal heir in the event of a registered worker's death due to an accident at the workplace. Additionally, ₹15,000/- will be provided for funeral expenses.

name: Mukhyamantri Swasthya Sahayata Yojana Jharkhand
brief: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Swasthya Sahayata Yojana" by the Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, & Backward Classes Welfare Department, Govt. of Jharkhand, aims to provide medical financial aid to beneficiaries. It covers illnesses, surgeries, & nutritional support during & after treatment.

name: Mukhya Mantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
brief: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from all sections of Rajasthan who are pursuing higher education at IITs, IIMs, and other national-level institutions. Under this scheme, 50% of the non-refundable fees are reimbursed to eligible students.

name: Mukhya Mantri Sahara Yojana
brief: The State Government has launched the 'Sahara Scheme' to provide financial assistance of Rs. 3000 per month to the patients belonging to the economically weaker sections of the society, who are suffering from specified diseases such Parkinson, Malignant Cancer, Paralysis etc.

name: Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana - Jharkhand
brief: The "Mukhymantri Sarthi Yojana" aims to provide industry-relevant skill development training for youth in Jharkhand, aligning with NSQF standards. Implemented by Jharkhand Skill Development Mission Society (JSDMS) across all 24 districts, it offers free training to enhance employability.

name: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for establishing new enterprises or upgrading existing small-scale units.

name: Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana Ati Sukshm (Nano) Udhyam
brief: The scheme aims to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance through banks to facilitate the establishment of new micro (nano) enterprises as well as the expansion of existing businesses.

name: Mukhyamantri Majadoor Suraksha Yojana
brief: Mukhyamantri Majdur Suraksha Yojana provides registered rural and agriculture-based labourers in Madhya Pradesh with maternity assistance, scholarships for children, insurance cover and wage-loss compensation. Ensures social security for unorganised workers’ families.

name: Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar
brief: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Matrupushti Uphar” was launched by the Directorate of Social Welfare and Social Education, Government of Tripura, to provide financial assistance of ₹500/- to pregnant women through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for antenatal checkups at any health facility.

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana
brief: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women in the state. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs and to promote their entrepreneurial spirit.

name: Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial grants for the construction of houses to economically weak widows and single women.

name: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Protsahan Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, an incentive amount is provided to minority students who pass the Intermediate/Matriculation/Fauquania/Maulvi examinations with first-class marks from the Bihar School Examination Board/Bihar Madrasa Education Board.

name: Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana
brief: This scheme provides financial assistance to landless beneficiaries for purchasing residential land, ensuring housing for the underprivileged in rural Bihar.

name: Mukhya Mantri Vivah Shagun Yojna
brief: This scheme is being implemented to honor the girl child and to ensure that the girls from poor families and daughters of widows/destitute women, sports women & orphan girl children, are married gracefully. For this purpose, grant is given to eligible persons to cover marriage expenses.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidhyarti Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to cover the tuition fees for meritorious students from Madhya Pradesh admitted to graduate courses. Financial assistance for admission and course fees is provided to eligible students through this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Swaraozgar Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment. Under this scheme, a loan of ₹5,00,000/- will be provided to specially-abled individuals in the state whose annual family income does not exceed ₹2,00,000/-, enabling them to start their own business.

name: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to enhance maternal and child health by providing nutritional support to first-time pregnant women and mothers of young children during the crucial first 1000 days of life.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana
brief: The Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana scheme was launched by the Department of Skill, Employment, Entrepreneurship and Innovation to enhance candidates' employability through practical training with entrepreneurs with a budget of ₹5,500 crore.

name: Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 06 January 2012.

name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to support poor families by reducing their household fuel expenses. Under this scheme, Antyodaya (pink card) ration card holders in the state are entitled to receive three free gas cylinder refills every year.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas Evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur suraksha upakaran sahaayata yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Suraksha Upakaran Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction workers.

name: Mukhyamantri Nijee Nalkup Yojana
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to support farmers in ensuring water availability through borewell construction and motor pump installation.

name: Micro Nutrient Spray
brief: The “Micro Nutrient Spray” scheme provides a 50% subsidy or ₹70/- per hectare to eligible farmers, with a focus on ensuring benefits to SC/ST and women farmers.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 11 January 2012.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana
brief: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh started this scheme on March 1, 2023, under the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board." The scheme provides free coaching assistance for children of construction workers.

name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata" for Building and other construction worker on 29 March 2023.

name: Mukhyamantri Nischay Swayam Sahayata Bhatta Yojna
brief: The allowance will be provided by the Government of Bihar to the educated unemployed citizens under the Chief Minister Self Help Allowance Scheme. So that the citizens of the state do not have to face financial crisis.

name: Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh State Government started "Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana" for the girl child of the family.

name: Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana
brief: The "Mahila Nirman Shramik Vivah Yojana" was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, under the Labour Department of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered female construction workers and maximum of two of their daughters.

name: Mahila Nursery Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to promote nursery establishment by providing women's groups with high-quality seedlings or saplings from certified sources, along with a fixed grant, technical support, and training to ensure effective nursery operations.

name: Mukhyamantri Nidan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide free quality diagnostic facilities at all government health institutions in Gujarat. It benefits rural population by offering essential laboratory tests, X-ray, sonography services without charge at nearby government healthcare centers.

name: Modernisation And Removal Of Obsolescence
brief: MODROB scheme, one of the AICTE Quality Improvement Scheme (AQIS), intends to support the development of laboratories with appropriate equipment/ technology/ tools/ software and encourages financial contribution from the industry.

name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change Internship Scheme
issuer: Ministry Of Environment,forests and climate change
brief: The Scheme seeks to engage students, with Graduation/Postgraduation Degrees, as well as Research Scholars, enrolled in recognized Universities / Institutions within India, or abroad, as “Interns”. These "Interns" shall be inducted all over the country in various Divisions/Units of the Ministry.

name: Monsanto Scholarship (M.Sc. Agriculture Science and Agriculture Biotechnology)
brief: he scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agricultural Science & Agricultural Biotechnology by awarding them scholarships for three semesters.

name: Special Basic Mountaineering Course
brief: The scheme aims to enhance mountaineering skills among youth, prepare them to become certified guides, and promote adventure tourism in Uttarakhand.

name: Madhya Pradesh Crime Victim Compensation Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial compensation and rehabilitation to victims of crime or their dependents by offering monetary support, medical treatment, and rehabilitation based on their loss, injury, and financial status.

name: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cow/Buffalo Ration Scheme For BPL Families Belonging To Scheduled Caste (SC) Category
brief: A scheme had been launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh with the aim to provides a 50% subsidy on a balanced ration for pregnant cows or buffalo during the last trimester of pregnancy.

name: Male Pig Distribution Scheme
brief: The "Male Pig Distribution Scheme", under the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of  Chhattisgarh, provides a grant to beneficiaries from the SC/ST category for purchasing one male pig of an improved breed (Middle White Yorkshire).

name: Meghalaya Piggery Development Scheme
brief: The Meghalaya Piggery Development Scheme is a component of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program launched by the Government of Meghalaya. It aims to employ, engage, and empower youth and rural communities by promoting piggery entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.

name: The Mizoram Provisional Employees Savings Scheme
brief:
This scheme laid out to allow the members to make defined contribution towards planned savings thereby securing the future in the form of pension. This Scheme shall be compulsory for all Provisional Employees whose
engagement is duly approved by DP&AR and Finance Department, Government of Mizoram.

name: Meghalaya Poultry Farming Scheme
brief: The Meghalaya Poultry Farming Scheme is a component under the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program launched  by the Government of Meghalaya. It aims to employ, engage, and empower the youth and rural communities by  promoting poultry entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.

name: Madhya Pradesh Fasal Vividhikaran (Crop Diversification) Encouragement Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to encourage crop diversification by providing necessary inputs to farmers who shift from growing wheat and paddy. Benefits are provided primarily to the implementing Company, Firm, or Institution to cover costs related to Human Resources and Marketing, benefiting farmers.

name: Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and foster quality education, research, development, and innovation.

name: Madhya Pradesh Janani Suraksha Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, cash incentives are provided to pregnant women and their motivators for delivery in government or accredited private hospitals.

name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Disability Assistance
brief: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to physically disabled artists and litterateurs for disability-related medical treatment and rehabilitation.

name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Death Assistance
brief: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance to the dependents of deceased artists and litterateurs.

name: Madhya Pradesh Kalakar Evam Sahityakar Kalyan Kosh Niyam- Serious Illness / Accident / Calamity Assistance
brief: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance for serious illness, accident, or calamity-related medical treatment to artists and litterateurs.

name: Madhya Pradesh Lok Vaniki Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide for the management of tree covered areas located on private land and revenue land under the MP Public Forestry Act, 2001. The scheme benefits landowners, Gram Panchayats, or Gram Sabhas by allowing them to undertake the scientific management of their tree covered areas.

name: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste students in standards 9 to 12. Through this scheme, eligible SC students receive free boarding, lodging, textbooks, uniforms, meals, and additional support services to enhance academic participation.

name: Monthly Pension for the Maintenance of the Parents of the Martyred Soldier of the Army
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹10,000 per month to the dependent parents of martyred soldiers for their maintenance and livelihood.

name: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
brief: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community" was launched by the Mizoram Scholarship Board, Government of Mizoram. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to students belonging to Scheduled Castes pursuing post-matriculation.

name: Madhya Pradesh Non-Government Institution Grant Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to support non-government cultural institutions by providing financial grants for cultural activities, training, equipment, and events.

name: Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana
brief: "Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana
brief: The "Mukhyamantri Pragatisheel Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana" is an initiative under the "Nand Baba Milk Mission" aimed to encourage the trend of rearing indigenous breed of cows with high quality and productivity in the state & motivate cattle farmers for breed improvement of cows, their better care.

name: Media Person Pension Scheme
brief: The scheme “Media Person Pension Scheme” was launched by the Department of Information, Public Relations and Languages, Haryana on 07th December 2017.

name: Madhya Pradesh Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme
brief: "M.P. Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme" aims to recognize and reward backward-class students who excel in professional entrance examinations. Monetary awards are provided to backward-class students who secure the top three positions in entrance examinations like PET, PPT, and MCA.

name: Post-matric Scholarship Scheme- Uttar Pradesh
brief: The UP scholarship program was started by the state of Uttar Pradesh to increase literacy rates and generate a skilled youth force to boost social and economic growth.

name: Matrutva Prasuvidha Yojana
brief: "Matrutva Prasuvidha Yojana" is a Medical Assistance scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹ 15,000/- for the first two deliveries of the registered female worker.

name: Matsya Pokhari Yojana
