brief: The scheme aims to promote scientific thinking and awareness among citizens by providing support and funding to educational institutions, R&D organizations, and NGOs to organize science communication activities.

name: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes
brief: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes aims to provide support for the betterment of Scheduled Caste (SC) candidates for coaching and pre examination training in quality coaching institutions to enable them to appear in competitive examinations.

name: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Tribes
brief: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Tribe aims to provide support for the betterment of Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates for coaching and pre examination training in quality coaching institutions to enable them to appear in competitive examinations.

name: Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar
brief: The scheme aims to recognize excellent work done by individuals and institutions in the field of disaster management including prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and rehabilitation.

name: Scheme for Celebration of Birth/death Anniversary of Eminent Personalities
brief: The "Scheme for Celebration of Birth/Death Anniversary of Eminent Personalities" scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the celebration of anniversaries/Jayanti's of Sant Kabir, Sant Gadge, and Sant Durbalnath and in addition to Anniversaries of DR. B.R. Ambedkar, etc.

name: Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme
brief: The scheme "Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial support for residential facilities to Scheduled Caste students who are studying in colleges outside their native village/city.

name: Scholarship for Children of Deceased/Disabled/Retired Government Employees
brief: The objective of this scheme is to motivate children of government employees who are deceased, retired, or disabled. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹50/- to ₹250/- are provided to children of these government employees who are studying in Class 1 to Class 12 in government schools.

name: Semi-Commercial Duck Farming
brief: The scheme “Semi-Commercial Duck Farming” started under the State Sector Scheme "Encouragement of Commercial Poultry Entrepreneur and Promotion of Backyard Poultry Production" to support small entrepreneurs in setting up Duck farms with a capacity of 1000 ducks.

name: Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana with the objective of encouraging the farmers for conservation and development of the indigenous breeds of cows and buffaloes.

name: Sikhligar’s Community Development Scheme
brief: The "Sikhligar’s Community Development Scheme" aims to promote economic self-reliance among the Sikhligara community, the Corporation will provide a subsidy and a subsidy of 33% of the vehicle cost for purchasing goods tempos, or vehicles to economically backward of Karnataka state.

name: Scheduled Caste Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.

name: "Subsidy for Cultivation of Fodder Crops" Component of the "Crop Production Technology" Scheme
brief: The "Subsidy for Cultivation of Fodder Crops" scheme was introduced by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, cash incentives are distributed to Farmers and Self Help Groups for undertaking fodder cultivation in the Puducherry region.

name: State Integrated Cooperative Development Project - Fisheries Sector
brief: The scheme aims to promote sustainable fisheries development in Uttarakhand by facilitating the establishment and expansion of cooperative-based fisheries projects in both mountainous and plain regions.

name: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Kiosks Including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental Fish-Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the construction of fish kiosks, including those for aquarium/ornamental fish.

name: SC Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste girl students of Madhya Pradesh enrolled in Class 11 to encourage them to continue their education and prevent dropouts.

name: Scheme of Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts duly registered under the Companies Act for their development
brief: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, provides Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts  for their development.

name: Scholarships for Top Class Education for students with Disabilities, DNH & DD
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Scholarship for Students with Disabilities, DNH & DD offers tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹1.9 lakh, maintenance allowance, book grant, laptop support, assistive devices, and special disability allowances for eligible UG/PG students in notified institutes. Income limit: ₹8 lakh p.a.

name: Sruthitharangam ( Cochlear Implantation Scheme )
brief: The Govt. of Kerala launched the “Sruthitharangam (Cochlear Implantation Scheme)” under Kerala Social Security Mission by the Social Justice Department, Kerala. This scheme envisioned providing free cochlear implantation surgery for children in the age group of 0-5 years, who are hearing impaired.

name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
issuer: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled scheme aims to facilitate capital subsidy to SC/ST MSEs for purchasing of plant & machinery/equipment through institutional finance (bank loan).

name: Share Capital to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme, 2008
brief: The "Share Capital to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme, 2008" aimed to encourage local youths to start income-generating activities and promote self-employment. The scheme provided financial support for individuals and groups, covering 50% of the project cost.

name: Scheme for Construction of Multipurpose Community Halls in Areas Inhabited by Tribal Community (Sanskruti Bhavan)
brief: The scheme aims to provide essential infrastructure by constructing Multipurpose Community Halls (Sanskruti Bhavan) in villages primarily inhabited by Scheduled Tribe Communities. Benefits include a facility that serves as a marriage hall, training center, and recreation room.

name: Scheme for Construction of Marriage Hall/ Community Hall/ Convention Centre/ Commercial Godown
brief: The scheme aims to assist Qualified Personnel in Medicine, Management, Accountancy, Engineering, Architecture, etc. and Good Borrowers of the Corporation (Industrial Units) for purchase of New Four Wheeler Vehicle (Air Conditioned or Non-air-conditioned) for own use. The applications are online.

name: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries.

name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Sainik School Imphal
brief:
The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently
residing in the States of studying at Sainik School Imphal, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces.

name: Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita
brief: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education among students by organizing Sanskrit competitions at various levels. Under this scheme, Sanskrit competitions are organized at various levels for both junior (Class 6 to 10) and senior (Class 11 to post-graduation) categories.

name: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
brief: In the year 1998, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of Schedule Cast.

name: Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman
brief: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students to pursue higher studies in Sanskrit by rewarding those who achieve top positions in the subject at the high school, intermediate, undergraduate, and postgraduate levels.

name: Scholarship For Cadets Of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun
brief: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently residing in the States of studying at RIMC, Dehradun, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces. The scheme is 100% funding from the State Plan Fund

name: Self-Certification Scheme
brief: The Labour Department, Government of Tripura, launched the Self-Certification Scheme aims for employers to self-certify their compliance with multiple labor laws, aiming to simplify inspections and reduce bureaucracy.

name: Seed Capital Scheme
brief: The scheme “Seed Capital Scheme” is a scheme by the Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communications, Government of Goa, for the Startups of Goa. Through this scheme, startups with a promising idea can get a one-time grant of up to ₹ 10,00,000.

name: Shop Construction/Shop Operation Scheme For Rehabilitation Of PwDs
brief: The "Shop Construction/Shop Operation Scheme For Rehabilitation Of PwDs" Scheme has been started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Uttar Pradesh.

name: Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP): Electrification of Wells of Scheduled Caste Farmers
brief: The scheme aims to provide agricultural electricity connections on a priority basis to Scheduled Caste farmers. Benefits include electrification of wells and free domestic electricity connections for Scheduled Caste farmers and beneficiaries across Gujarat.

name: AGR-4 Scheduled Castes Sub-Plan for Distribution of Seeds and Fertilizers Input Kits at Subsidised Rates to Scheduled Caste Cultivators
brief: The scheme aims to provide subsidised seeds, fertilizers, and organic inputs to Scheduled Caste farmers to improve agricultural productivity.

name: Senior Citizens Saving Scheme
brief: Introduced in 2004 by the Govt. of India, SCSS offers a steady stream of income for individuals over 60 years old. As it is a government-backed scheme, there is minimal risk associated with SCSS. Individuals can apply for this scheme in post offices and public and private banks.

name: Shramyogi Cycle Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide a subsidy for the purchase of a bicycle to laborers working in the organized sector, enabling them to commute between their residence and workplace.

name: Star College Scheme For Strengthening Of Science Education And Training At Undergraduate Level
brief: The Dept. of Biotechnology has launched "Star College Scheme for Strengthening of Science Education and Training at Undergraduate Level" for improving critical thinking and 'hands-on' experimental work at the undergraduate (college) level in sciences.

name: Scholarship to SC students studying in selected schools under Talentpool Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide the best education to meritorious Scheduled Caste students in high-quality residential schools to help them build their careers and improve their living standards.

name: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹12,000/- to registered construction workers for building toilets. The assistance is disbursed in two installments: the first installment of ₹8,000/- and the second installment of ₹4,000/-.

name: Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and Computer–Furniture to the Society
brief: The scheme aims to uplift Scheduled Castes by providing managerial salary and computer–furniture assistance to eligible cooperative societies.

name: Scheme for Cottage and Village Industries (Composite Loan Scheme)
brief: The scheme aims to extend composite financial assistance (term loan and/or working capital loan) to Artisans, Village and Cottage Industries, and Micro Enterprises promoted by residents of Puducherry. Benefits include loans up to ₹25,00,000/- per unit.

name: Saraswati Cycle Yojana
brief:
Chhattisgarh Saraswati Cycle Yojana has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh in 2004. 
Saraswati Cycle Yojana is being operated by the Department of School Education, Government of Chhattisgarh.

name: Sudama Shishyavritti Scheme (Class 11th and 12th)
brief: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools who reside in a hostel, have an annual family income of less than ₹1,00,000/-, and belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Shodhgrantha Chayan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to invite scholars from any state in India to submit research manuscripts on Sanskrit literature, as well as socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand.

name: Skill Development Allowance Scheme
brief: The Department of Labour & Employment, Government of Himachal Pradesh introduced a scheme of granting Skill Development Allowance to the unemployed youth aims at providing allowance to educated unemployed persons for their Skill upgradation.

name: Skill Development Assistance (ANBOCWWB)
issuer: Government of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided to registered construction workers or their two children for the purchase of tool kits upon submission of a successful course/trade completion certificate from a Government Industrial Training Institute or Vocational Training Centre.

name: Scheme of Development Assistance to Colleges for the Construction of Buildings
brief: The scheme aims to provide development assistance to Colleges to help in the consolidation and expansion of infrastructure. Financial assistance is provided to eligible Colleges for the construction and renovation of essential buildings like classrooms, laboratories, and hostels.

name: Skill Development and Economic Empowerment
brief: The scheme "Skill Development and Economic Empowerment" aims to provide vocational training and skill enhancement for visually challenged individuals. Through this scheme, free education, food, accommodation, and training in various job-oriented fields are provided to eligible candidates.

name: Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games
brief: The award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports & Games is a prestigious national sports award instituted by the Government of India to recognize coaches who have consistently demonstrated outstanding & meritorious work in training sportspersons to achieve excellence at international competitions.

name: Scholarship For Differently Abled Students
brief: The scheme “Scholarship for Differently Abled Students” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
brief: The scheme aims to train skilled professionals for the technical textiles industry, develop transferable skills, create a strong knowledge ecosystem, integrate trained individuals into various roles, and promote continuous learning and innovation.

name: Subsidy for Developing Business Premises for Persons with Disabilities
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes & Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam. Under this scheme, loans up to ₹3 lakh are provided to persons with disabilities to develop business premises on their own land & start self-employment activities.

name: Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal
brief: "Scheme of Death Benefit for Weavers & Artisans of West Bengal" is a social welfare scheme implemented by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal aims to provide financial assistance to the family of the deceased weaver /artisan.

name: Solo Drama Competition
brief: The scheme aims to promote solo theatrical performances and encourage talent in the field of drama across Gujarat. A state-level solo drama competition is organized with cash prizes awarded to winners and special category performers.

name: Sindhu Darshan Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, fostering national unity. Intended beneficiaries include native Gujaratis who complete the yatra and apply within 60 days.

name: Swahid Dayal Das Panika Swaniyojan Achoni
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the self-employed youths belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community in Assam to encourage and initiate self-employment activities. The benefit is financial support for self-employed youth to enhance their capabilities.

name: Stamp Duty Exemption for Property Registration
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial relief during property registration by offering exemptions or rebates in stamp duty to specific sections of society.

name: Scheme for ‘Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India’
issuer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
brief: The scheme aims to skill 3,28,000 candidates in the ESDM sector. Through this scheme, training and certification benefits are provided to students and unemployed youth.

name: Skill Development Fee Reimbursement Scheme
brief: Through the “Skill Development Fee Reimbursement Scheme”, the SPC will reimburse 50% of the fees up to ₹ 50,000/- to the students who have successfully completed an SPC-approved technical skill training program in any of the approved domains from a Goan educational institute.

name: Spices Development Ginger, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Coriander, Cinnamon and Chillies
brief: The objective of the scheme is to encourage farmers to produce good quality and diseased-free planting materials and to grow improved varieties of high-yielding spices.

name: Stamp Duty Refund
brief: The Government of Haryana offers reimbursement of stamp duty charges to incentivize industrial investment and infrastructure development across the state. This scheme provides financial relief on stamp duty paid during land or property registration for eligible sectors and locations.

name: Scheme for Development Maintenance and Construction of Roads
brief: The "Development Maintenance and Construction of Roads" was launched by the Pondicherry Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited (PIPDIC), Department of Industries & Commerce. The scheme aims to assist SSI units for the Development & Maintenance and Construction of Roads.

name: State Disability Pension
brief: The Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Mizoram launched the State Disability Pension scheme. It provides a monthly pension of ₹350 to 200 eligible individuals who are completely blind or bedridden.

name: Skill Development Promotion Scheme
brief: Through the “Skill Development Promotion Scheme”, the retail educational institutes that impart programming and technical skills are encouraged to establish learning centres in Goa. Institutes listed by the startup promotion cell and providing courses at pre-fixed rates will be provided subsidies.

name: Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.

name: Skill Development Programme- Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to enhance the employability and entrepreneurial skills of students, researchers, and farmers in the field of biotechnology, thereby promoting self-employment and entrepreneurship in emerging areas of the biotechnology sector.

name: Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged
brief: The "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme aims to distribute daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18.

name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)
brief: “Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)” incentives under “Banglashree for MSMEs” scheme implemented by the MSMEs Dept., Government of West Bengal, provides a reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fee paid by the eligible enterprises for the purpose of registration of documents.

name: Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme
brief: Through “Stamp Duty Reimbursement Scheme”, in case of land/ developed area purchased/ leased by Start-ups/ incubators/ accelerators, the stamp duty for land area lease/ sale transaction for start-ups/incubators/ accelerators will not exceed ₹ 100/-, and the excess amount paid will be reimbursed.

name: Sugar Distribution Scheme
brief: The "Sugar Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide subsidized sugar to AAY households under NFSA, ensuring access to essential food commodities at affordable rates.

name: Skill Development Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief: The Board is implementing this scheme by entering an MoU with M/s Labour Net Services Private Limited and M/s G&G Skill Developers Private Limited, to provide training to the Construction Workers enrolled as beneficiaries in the Board. The applications are accepted offline.

name: Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8)
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹600/- for students in Class 1 to 5 and ₹960/- for students in Class 6 to 8, to regularly enrolled disable students.

name: Salt Distribution Scheme Jharkhand
brief: The "Salt Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, ensures subsidized salt is provided to AAY, PHH, and Green Cardholders, promoting accessibility and affordability.

name: Sindhu Darshan Scheme in Ladakh
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the pilgrims of the state going on Sindhu Darshan pilgrimage. Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.

name: Supply of Dhotis and Sarees to Scheduled Caste (SC) People
brief: The scheme “Supply of Dhotis and Sarees to Scheduled Caste (SC) People” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department, Union Territory of Puducherry is introduced to provide clothing items (lungi, shirt, saree, blouse, etc) to the Scheduled Caste (SC) people of Puducherry.

name: State Disability Scholarship (Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities)
brief: The scheme “State Disability Scholarship” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Nagaland to provide financial assistance to students from Class I to Class VIII who have a disability of 40% and above.

name: Skill Development Training - 15 Days Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Training Programme at Work Site
brief: The Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers offers a 15-day Recognition of Prior Learning training programme for registered construction workers. The programme aims to enhance the employability of workers, ensuring they meet industry standards for future opportunities.

name: Skill Development Training - 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme
brief: The Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers a 90-day residential skill development training program designed for unemployed youth who are dependents of registered construction workers.

name: Skill Development Training - 90 Days Skill Development Training Programme in Curtain & Garment Stitching
brief: The Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers a 90-day non-residential skill development training programme specifically designed for unemployed girls and women who are dependents of registered construction workers.

name: Skill Development Training Karnataka
brief: The Skill Development Training program aims to equip artisans with the skills necessary for the manufacture of footwear and leather goods. The project promotes the leather industry while enhancing the livelihoods of artisans.

name: Skill Development Training Manipur
brief: The Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board offers "Skill Development Training" to registered building workers, their spouse, dependent siblings, and children. The training includes vocational and skill development courses from recognized government and private providers.

name: Seed Grant
brief: The scheme aims to provide seeds to farmers at a concessional rate during Kisan Melas with a subsidy of up to 15%.

name: Skill Development
brief: The scheme "Skill Development" by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, aims to impart practical training to postgraduate students in various Earth Science disciplines, including structural and evolutionary geology, geochemistry, geomorphology, glaciology, magnetostratigraphy, etc.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals to support a happy married life after marriage. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided.

name: Subsidy for Disabled Young Professionals
brief: Under this scheme, loans up to ₹25,00,000/- are provided to professionally educated unemployed disabled youth who fall under the OH, VH, HH, or MR categories, at different interest rates ranging from 4.5% to 8% per annum.

name: Solar Energy Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme aims to provide solar energy plates/panels to the families of construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

name: SEBI ITD Internship Program
brief: The SEBI ITD Internship Program provides hands-on training to the students of the institutes based in and around Mumbai. The program accepts up to 15 interns. The Interns accepted under this program would be given an opportunity to work on different Information Technology (IT) projects.

name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units
brief: The objective of the scheme is to improve the socio-economic and nutritional status of the poor families, small farmers and landless agricultural labourers and other economically weaker section of the society.

name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, 50 chicks of 10 days of age from the Government Hatchery Farm along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.

name: Special Education - Tamil Nadu
brief: The scheme 'Special Education by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide free special education, & vocational training to the visually impaired, hearing-impaired person.

name: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Internship
issuer: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
brief: The SECI Internship Policy is designed to provide practical experience to students in the renewable energy sector. The program aims to give interns exposure to SECI's various divisions, helping them understand the renewable energy sector.

name: Scheme to Encourage the Children of Sanitation Workers Who have Passed the Class 10/12 Examination (GSKVN)
brief: Under this scheme, children of sanitation workers who have achieved first, second, or third rank in the board exams of Class 10 and Class 12 (General Stream and Science Stream) across the state are awarded cash prizes and certificates of appreciation.

name: Silage evam Dudharu Pashu Poshan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to improve the nutrition of dairy animals and enhance milk production by providing subsidized silage and feed to members of milk cooperative societies.

name: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes - "Educational Empowerment" Component
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The scheme aims to provide good coaching quality for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations. Provides free coaching and stipend support to students from these marginalized communities.

name: Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers across Gujarat in adding value to their crops by providing financial assistance for purchasing machinery.

name: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, a resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of two milch animals. The subsidy can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units with two milch animals.

name: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units
brief: Under this scheme, unemployed persons will be assisted by way of providing financial assistance in form of subsidy for establishing dairy units of 4, 10, 20 & 50 milch animals like buffaloes, indigenous cows (Hariana, Sahiwal, Belahi, Red Sindhi, Tharparkar and Gir breeds only) and crossbred cows.

name: Spurring Entrepreneurship Initiative
brief: Spurring Entrepreneurship Initiative is a scheme to provide financial assistance to youth of Union Territory of J&K for establishing their business units with a special focus on high-growth entrepreneurship.

name: Schooling Education (JKBOCWWB)
brief: The scheme "Schooling Education" by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., J&K, provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers, from Class Nursery/1st to 5th, and from Class 6th to 8th.

name: Self-Employment loan scheme for Minority Widows, Divorcees / Abandoned Women
brief: The scheme aims to provide self-employment loans to women from minority communities. Financial assistance with a 20% subsidy is provided to widows, divorced women, and abandoned women from minority communities. The scheme is implemented by the KSMDFC.

name: Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards for Marriages Between Persons with Differently Abled and Normal Persons
brief: The scheme "Sanction of Enhancement of Marriage Incentive Awards..." by the Dept. of Social Welfare, WCD Dept., Govt. of Andhra Pradesh aims to promote inter-abled marriages. It provides ₹1,50,000/- to eligible differently abled persons as a one-time incentive.

name: ICSSR Senior Fellowship
brief: The Indian Council of Social scientific Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, offers a Senior Fellowship Scheme designed to assist accomplished Indian researchers in conducting advanced social science research.

name: Simplification of Sale Process of Herbal Products - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to simplify the sale process of medicinal and aromatic products produced by cultivators, enabling them to legally and easily sell their produce through authorized markets or buyers.

name: SERB - POWER Fellowship
brief: The SERB - POWER Fellowship is designed to identify and reward excellent women researchers in Indian academic institutions and R&D laboratories, holding Ph.D. degrees in any branch of science and engineering.

name: SERB - POWER Research Grants
brief: The aim of the ‘SERB - POWER Research Grants’ is to encourage emerging and eminent women researchers for individual-centric and competitive mode of research funding to undertake R&D activities in frontier areas of science and engineering.

name: SERB Research Scientist Scheme
brief: SERB Board has launched a new ‘SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme’ for the awardees of INSPIRE Faculty and Ramanujan Fellowships, who fail to secure regular positions after completion of the regular tenure of five years in the respective schemes.

name: Self Employment Scheme
brief: Under this scheme, Subsidies will be provided to the religious minority communities with the help of Nationalized / Scheduled banks to start or improve a small-scale handicraft industry, service sector,  and agro-based activities.

name: Self Employment Scheme - Goa
brief: "Self Employment Scheme" provides financial support up to a maximum of ₹ 10,00,000 to any individual person belonging to Scheduled Tribes Community to undertake any self-employment activities.

name: Self Employment Scheme Gujarat
brief: The scheme provides unemployed tribal persons with affordable loans ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate, aiming to help them establish self-employment opportunities.

name: Scheme to Encourage Students for Innovative Projects
brief: The scheme aims to encourage students in the State of Goa who have technological innovative ideas, which they want to translate into a working prototype, by providing financial assistance. It offers financial support of up to ₹50,000/- to eligible students for innovative academic projects.

name: Self-Employment Scheme: Nana Vyavasay Mate Loan Yojana
brief: "Nana Vyavasay Mate Loan Yojana" is a component under the "Self-Employment Scheme" that provides financial assistance in the form of a loan to establish or expand small businesses such as grocery shops, medical stores, bookstores, etc.

name: Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes
brief: The scheme aims to support scheduled castes and scheduled tribes families below the poverty line through concessional loans and subsidies for self-employment in various sectors.

name: Self-Employment Scheme: Transport/ Logistics/ Travels/ Food Court Wyaaj Sahaay
brief: "Transport/ Logistics/ Travels/ Food Court Wyaaj Sahaay" is a component under the "Self-Employment Scheme" that provides 5% interest subsidy on a bank loan of ₹6,00,000/- for purchasing vehicles and setting up the required infrastructure.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting Up Anchor Institute
brief: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Skill Development to MSME Sector
brief: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting-up of Specialized Skill Development Centers at Industry
brief: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Running Short-term Bridge Courses
brief: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Skill Up-gradation Centers (SUCs)
brief: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Tuition Fees for Enhancement of Skill
brief: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

name: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
brief: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability between the age group of 6 to 18 years in the Government Special Schools and Vocational Training is provided to special children above the age of 18 years. Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance in Case of Death
brief: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance in Case of Death" scheme was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the nominee or spouse or dependent of the deceased registered beneficiary.

name: Scheme for Funeral Assistance in Case of Death of Registered Construction Worker
brief: The "Scheme for Funeral Assistance in Case of Death of Registered Construction Worker" was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Tripura. The scheme aims to provide funeral assistance in case of the death of registered construction workers.

name: Subsidy for Asset Creation for Intellectual Property: Patent Registration
brief: The scheme "Subsidy for Asset Creation for Intellectual Property: Patent Registration" by the Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu, is introduced to incentivize MSMEs to innovate and create intellectual property in India and Abroad as a differentiator.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Cultural Organization for Holding Conference, Seminar, Symposium, Exhibition, Festival, Competition etc.
brief: The Arts and Culture Department launched the "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Cultural Organization for Holding Conference, Seminar, Symposium, Exhibition, Festival, Competition etc." The scheme aims to provide annual grant to the institution/organization organizing a seminar, symposium.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations
brief: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Dance and Drama Troupes/Associations" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide a grant for dance and drama troupes/associations.

name: Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure
brief: The “Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure” aims to support the development and upgradation of industrial infrastructure in the state.

name: Kishori Balika Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
brief: The scheme "Kishori Balika Yojana" by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide vocational, health, and hygiene training to adolescent girls. Through this scheme, training and material assistance are provided to the girls.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance to IHMs/FCIs/IITTM/ICI/NCHMCT/PSUs
brief: The scheme aims to provide Central Financial Assistance for setting up, expanding, upgrading, and replacing equipment for institutions involved in tourism and hospitality education and capacity building. Benefits include capital grants for construction and equipment.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Capital Subsidy
brief: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities" under the Gujarat Integrated Logistics and Logistics Park Policy, provides financial support to private developers for creating logistics facilities and parks with the necessary infrastructure and services.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Exemption of Electricity Duty
brief: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities" under the Gujarat Integrated Logistics and Logistics Park Policy, provides financial support to private developers for creating logistics facilities and parks with the necessary infrastructure and services.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Interest Subsidy
brief: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities" under the Gujarat Integrated Logistics and Logistics Park Policy, provides financial support to private developers for creating logistics facilities and parks with the necessary infrastructure and services.

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty
brief: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities" under the Gujarat Integrated Logistics and Logistics Park Policy, provides financial support to private developers for creating logistics facilities and parks with the necessary infrastructure and services.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance to Literary/Educational Institutions for Organizing Programs/Conferences
brief: The scheme aims to encourage intellectual and cultural activities by providing financial support to institutions conducting seminars, workshops, symposiums, and literary programs.

name: Scheme for Assistance to Logistic Park
brief: The "Scheme for Financial Assistance to Logistic Parks" aims to promote the development of logistic parks to enhance infrastructure and streamline the supply chain across the state.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance to New Writers of Gujarati Language and Literature for Publishing Original Works of Creative and Fine Literature
brief: The scheme aims to financially support new writers in the Gujarati language who wish to publish original works of creative and literary merit.

name: Scheme for Acquisition of Equipment and Others
brief: The scheme aims to assist organizations in the small-scale sector in acquiring essential infrastructure and technology upgrades. The scheme provides need-based financial assistance for in-house quality control facilities, DG sets, pollution control equipment, computers and related accessories.

name: Scheme Of Financial Assistance For The Preservation And Development Of Cultural Heritage Of The Himalayas
brief: The scheme “Scheme of Financial Assistance for the Preservation and Development of Cultural Heritage of the Himalayas” was launched by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.

name: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals
brief: The "Scheme of Financial Assistance for Publication of Manuscripts/Research Journals" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department of Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for publishing manuscripts/research journals.

name: Silicosis Financial Assistance Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to heirs of workers engaged in Akik occupation who died due to silicosis disease. It benefits the families of deceased workers with monetary compensation of ₹1,00,000/- as support for occupational disease-related deaths.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Assistance to Enroll and Participate for Acceleration Program
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Interest Subsidy
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Pre- Series A Funding
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Sustenance Allowance
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Assistance for Skill Development
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Seed Support
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Scheme or assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society
brief: The "Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy, aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.

name: Special Financial Assistance Scheme for Meritorious Students of the State for Preparation of Competitive Examinations
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support of ₹50,000/- to meritorious students who have cleared the preliminary examination conducted by the State or Union Public Service Commission for Group 'A' and 'B' services, or the written examination for the Armed Forces (e.g., NDA, CDS, OTA, etc.).

name: Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for the Under Graduate Meritorious Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University
brief: The "Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for the Under Graduate Meritorious Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University" provides monthly scholarships to students pursuing Under Graduate in various faculties at Junagadh Agricultural University.

name: Scheme for Awards to MSMES
brief: The Government of Gujarat has introduced the "Scheme for Awards to MSMEs" under the Industrial Policy 2020. This scheme aims to recognize and reward Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) for their outstanding achievements in production, quality improvement, innovation, and entrepreneurship.

name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance for Translation of Scholarly Works
brief: The scheme aims to encourage cultural exchange and literary development by providing financial assistance for translating high-quality literary and research works between Gujarati and other Indian languages.

name: Scheme For Financial Assistance For Veteran Artists
brief: A pension scheme by MoC improves the financial and socio-economic status of the old artists and scholars who have contributed significantly in their specialized fields. Still, due to old age, they have to lead a miserable life or are in penury condition.

name: Subsidy For Battery Operated Three-Wheelers
brief: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote the adoption of eco-friendly vehicles by providing a subsidy on the purchase of battery-operated three-wheelers.

name: Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers
brief: This scheme is introduced by the Climate Change Department, Gujarat, aims to promote renewable energy and clean transportation by providing a subsidy to students for the purchase of battery-operated two-wheelers from authorized manufacturers.

name: Contribution to State Agriculture Marketing Board Development Fund (General)
brief: The scheme "Contribution to State Agriculture Marketing Board Development Fund (General)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to strengthen market infrastructure through financial assistance to State Agriculture Marketing Boards.

name: Scholarship for Chhattisgarh Students Studying Outside the State
brief: The scheme aims to support native Chhattisgarh students pursuing engineering degrees outside the state by providing a monthly scholarship of ₹2,000/-. This initiative benefits meritorious students enrolled in recognised engineering colleges outside Chhattisgarh.

name: Scheme for Campaign, Seminar and Sports under Disability Sector
brief: The scheme aims to extend financial support for National & International Events organized by reputed organizations or an individual person with disabilities working for welfare of Persons with Disabilities.

name: Scholarship for Engineering and Medical Education
brief: The scheme aims to support the higher education of dependents of ex-servicemen by providing financial assistance for pursuing engineering, medical, and PhD courses. Under this scheme, annual scholarships are awarded to beneficiaries based on their course of study.

name: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana
brief: This scheme provides capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to general , schedule caste and women beneficiaries .

name: Subsidy for Fund Raising from SME Exchange
brief: The scheme "Subsidy for Fund Raising from SME Exchange" by the Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu, is introduced with the objective to facilitate high growth potential SMEs in the State to raise equity capital through SME Exchange utilizing IPOs.

name: Scholarship for Fatherless Girls
brief: The objective of this scheme is to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12.

name: Scheme for Giving Awards to Junior Artists in Contemporary Art Field
brief: The "Scheme for Giving Awards to Junior Artists in Contemporary Art Field" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage junior artists towards Painting & Sculpture arts by giving an award of ₹10,000/- at the state-level contemporary art exhibition.

name: Scheme for Giving Awards to Senior Artists in Contemporary Art Field
brief: The "Scheme for Giving Awards to Senior Artists in Contemporary Art Field" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage senior artists & develop the Painting & Sculpture arts by giving an award of ₹15,000/- at the state-level contemporary art exhibition.

name: Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists
brief: Through the "Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists", awards are conferred to the participant artists whose works are adjudged outstanding among the entries at the State-level Traditional Art Exhibition conducted by the Kuzhu. The awarded works are put on display for public view.

name: Sudakshya For Girls Child Scholarship
brief: This scholarship provides financial assistance to all deserving students who want to pursue higher studies.  Under this scholarship scheme, the students fulfilling the eligibility criteria will receive a maintenance allowance and other benefits.

name: Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist Who Was Receiving Financial Assistance
brief: "Scheme for Giving Financial Assistance to the Legal Heirs of the Deceased Artist (Wife/Husband) on the Death of the Indigent Artist who was Receiving Financial Assistance" was launched by the Art and Culture Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu. ₹3,000/- is given to the eligible legal heir of the deceased.

name: Scheme for Fencing in Gardens
brief: The scheme aims to protect fruit plants, horticultural crops, and orchards from wild animals by providing financial assistance for fencing.

name: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports: Assistance for Research
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for sports-related research projects that contribute to the improvement of sports and games in India and promote innovation in sports sciences, medicine, psychology, performance enhancement, and other sports-related disciplines.

name: Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)
brief: The scheme "Scheme for Integrated Development for Horticulture (HRT-2)" aims to promote holistic horticultural growth through financial assistance for production, processing, marketing, and infrastructure support to farmers across Gujarat.

name: PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana
brief: The scheme under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for freshwater aquaculture in newly constructed ponds to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

name: PMMSY: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture - Haryana
brief: The subsidy for Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

name: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana
brief: The subsidy for 30-ton capacity ice plants/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana
brief: This scheme provides financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana
brief: The subsidy for 10-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana
brief: The subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.

name: State Fisheries Input Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to aims to enhance the productivity and income of fish farmers by providing financial support in the form of subsidies on essential fishery inputs such as hand nets, hapa, nets, mini kits, etc.

name: Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education
brief: The scheme aims to provide free laptops to visually impaired students pursuing courses. The scheme is provisioned for providing laptops to the visually impaired students to pursue professional courses after XII, under-graduate and post-graduate courses.

name: Scheme for Maternity Benefit
brief: The Scheme for Maternity Benefit was launched by the Tripura Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, under the Labour Department of Tripura. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered female construction workers after delivery

name: Full Medical Checkup Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
brief: The objective of the scheme is to conduct health check-ups for male Shramyogis above 45 years of age and female Shram Yogis above 35 years of age who are working in the organized sector in the state of Gujarat.

name: Scheme for Meritorious Students to Pursue Higher Secondary Education in the Best Schools of Tamil Nadu
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to the top 10 students from each district (based on 10th-grade public exam results) who study in government high schools, enabling them to pursue higher secondary education in select private schools of their choice across Tamil Nadu.

name: Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
brief: The Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad by the Madhya Pradesh Government provides aid to 20 students yearly with family income under ₹8 lakh, 75% in postgraduation, and teaching experience or an M.Phil degree.

name: Scholarship to Poor Students
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.

name: Scheme for Pension Benefits to the Journalists/Photojournalists
brief: "Scheme for Pension Benefits to the Journalists/photojournalists" was launched by the Department of Information and Cultural Affairs, Govt. of Tripura aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a Pension of ₹1000/- to retired Journalists/ photojournalists.

name: Sthaniya Fasal Protsahan Karyakram
brief: The program aims to promote the cultivation of local crops, enhance productivity, ensure the use of quality seeds, and provide fair prices to farmers in the mountain districts of Uttarakhand.

name: Scheme for Promotion of Protected Cultivation of Commercial Horticultural Crops
brief: The scheme aims to promote the protected cultivation of commercial horticultural crops by providing financial assistance to farmers. The scheme supports greenhouse, shade net, low tunnel, plastic mulching, bird/hail net, and cultivation of vegetables and flowers under polyhouse/shade net house.

name: Scheme for Rearing Purebreed Gir/ Kankarage Male Cow Calves with Excellent Genetic Quality
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to registered Gaushalas for rearing purebred Gir or Kankrej male cow calves with high genetic quality to promote pure breeding in indigenous cattle.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles – Haryana
brief: The scheme aims to enhance cold chain infrastructure & ensure hygienic and efficient fish transportation. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing refrigerated vehicles to maintain the freshness & quality of fish during post-harvest handling & transportation.

name: Seed Farms Scheme
brief: The objective of the scheme is the production of high-quality seeds of cereals, pulses, oilseeds, etc. and for raising Horticultural seedlings such as orange, coconut, arecanut etc. for distribution to cultivators.

name: Scheme For Study In Abroad
brief: In the year 2010-11, Rajasthan Government has taken the initiative to encourage girl child education by starting a scheme to Study Abroad.

name: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT
brief: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to Nomadic and De-notified Tribe students for pursuing higher education in self-financed colleges.

name: Scheme for Supportive Money to the Parents of Transgender Children
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The "Scheme for Supportive Money to the Parents of Transgender Children" aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to the parents of transgender children. Transgender persons face stigma and discrimination in almost every sphere of their life including within the group, health facilities.

name: Scheme for Supply of Improved Seeds for Fodder
brief: The "Scheme for Supply of Improved Seeds for Fodder" aims to supply improved quality fodder seeds to registered Gaushalas and Panjarapols to ensure round-the-year green fodder availability for livestock.

name: Scheme for Supply of Male Goat on Subsidy Basis
brief: "Male Goat Supply Scheme on Grant Basis" aims to improve the breed of indigenous/local goats throughout the state. Through this scheme, one male goat of an improved breed (Jamnapari, Barbari, or Sirohi Bakra) is provided to goat farmers of all categories on a grant basis.

name: Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State
brief: The scheme supports students in their first year and fills vacant awards in subsequent years (II/III/IV). Key benefits include financial aid to cover educational expenses and encouragement for students to pursue quality education. Eligible applicants must be Chhattisgarh domicile.

name: Scheme for Small Road Transport Operators (SRTOs)
brief: The scheme aims to extend financial assistance for acquiring new transport vehicles, including goods and passenger vehicles. It provides term loans covering up to 70% of the vehicle cost, excluding road tax and insurance, repayable over a max. of 58 monthly instalments.

name: Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector (PIPDIC)
brief: The scheme aims to extend financial support to establish new, or expand/modernize existing, Small Scale Industry and Medium Scale Industry units. Benefits include term loans up to ₹10,00,00,000/- for fixed asset acquisition.

name: Scheme of Free Supply of Textbooks, Stationery, Uniforms and Footwears to Poor Children
brief: Through this scheme, textbooks, notebooks, Uniforms, dictionaries, stationery, etc. are provided free of cost to all students studying in LKG to 12th Standard of all Government and Government-aided Private Schools. The objective of this scheme is to achieve 100% student enrolment.

name: Subsidy for School Uniforms to the Students
brief: The scheme aims to provide cash subsidies for school uniforms to students from Nursery to Class XII in government and aided schools. Benefits include annual payments ranging from ₹1,100/- to ₹1,500/-, ensuring financial support for all eligible students.

name: Scheme for the Funeral Expenses
brief: The "Scheme for the Funeral Expenses" by the Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial support to the family of a registered building and construction worker in the event of their death, whether due to natural causes or an accident.

name: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
brief: The "Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole"  aims to promote indigenous cow breeds and make cow rearing economically viable.

name: The Scheme for Fellowship to Under Graduate Students for Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University
brief: "The Scheme for Fellowship to Under Graduate Students for Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University" provides monthly fellowship to meritorious undergraduate students across various faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries
issuer: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief: To make the traditional industries more productive and competitive and facilitating their sustainable development, the Govt. of India announced in 2005-06, setting up of a fund for the regeneration of traditional industries. Pursuant to this announcement, a Central Sector Scheme titled the “SFURTI".

name: Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5
brief: The "Scheme for Fruit and Vegetable Preservation and Training Program in Horticulture Department HRT 5" aims to enhance the skills of women through training on value addition, preservation, and kitchen gardening of horticultural produce, while also providing a daily stipend and training support.

name: Scheme For Women Entrepreneurs Mahila Udyam Nidhi (MUN)
brief: The scheme aims to meet the equity gap for new Small Scale Industrial units and service activities promoted by women entrepreneurs. It offers Term Loans and Seed Capital for projects costing up to ₹10,00,000/-.

name: State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
brief: The scheme aims to provide rice at subsidized rates to yellow ration card holders in the state, under which 7.50 kg of rice is distributed to each card holder every month at the rate of ₹11.00 per kg.

name: Spectacle Grant (Sainik Welfare)
brief: "Spectacle Grant" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, ₹2,000/- to the Ex-servicemen/Widows of Ex-servicemen for the purchase of Spectacle. The members of the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme are not eligible.

name: Shilp Guru Award
brief: The “Shilp Guru Award” for master craftspersons was introduced by the Ministry of Textiles to honor legendary master craftspersons of handicrafts whose work and dedication have contributed not only to the preservation but also to the promotion of the rich and diverse craft heritage of the country.

name: Scheme for Granting Assistance to Processing Units in APMC (General Area)
brief: The scheme aims to promote agro-processing and value addition by providing capital investment assistance to private entrepreneurs operating in regulated APMC areas (general zones).

name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India Post-Senior Secondary Courses (Post 10+2 Courses)
issuer: Government of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide additional financial assistance (scholarship) to the ST students pursuing higher education after Senior Secondary i.e. 12th Standard in the Colleges/Universities anywhere in India, as an incentive to supplement the cost of their education.

name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level (Except Class XI & XII)
issuer: Government of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide additional scholarship to the OBC students belonging to the non-creamy layer of Andaman & Nicobar Islands for pursuing higher education after Secondary (X)/Senior Secondary (XII), in government-recognized Polytechnic/ITI/College/University anywhere in India.

name: Sikkim Grant Of Award To Transgender
brief: The scheme “Sikkim Grant of Award To Transgender (SGATT)” was launched in 2013 by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim. Under this scheme, the state government provides financial assistance to transgender belonging to a household of the Below Poverty Line category.

name: State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)
brief: The scheme is implemented by the School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to ensure the continuity of education for students from the Backward Classes. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Backward Classes students studying in Classes 6 to 10.

name: 100% State Government Divyangjan Term Loan Yojana
brief: The scheme provides provide financial support to native residents of Gujarat who have a disability of 40% or more. The eligible individuals can avail of a term loan ranging from ₹50,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate of 6% per annum for a repayment period of five years.

name: State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme
brief: The "State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme", initiated by the Animal Husbandry Department of Chhattisgarh, aims to promote goat farming as a sustainable livelihood option. Goat rearing has been a traditional occupation, and with increasing demand for milk and meat.

name: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance for Administering Road Safety Advocacy and Awards for the Outstanding Work Done in the Field of Road Safety
brief: The objective of the Scheme is to stimulate and encourage opportunities for various agencies through participation, in order to create awareness on road safety.

name: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance to Industrial Workers/Employee for Purchase of Spectacles
brief: The "Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance to Industrial Workers/Employee for Purchase of Spectacles" by the Goa Labour Welfare Board, Department of Labour and Employment, Goa, aims to provide financial aid to industrial workers/employees for acquiring spectacles. Through this scheme, assistance

name: State Government Health Scheme (Golden Card)
brief: The scheme aims to provide quality healthcare facilities to all government employees, pensioners, and their dependents in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, prescribed medical treatment is provided free of cost.

name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary and other Organizations Working for Scheduled Castes
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The "Scheme aims to enhance the reach of development interventions of the Government and fill the gaps in service-deficient Scheduled Caste-dominant areas in sectors such as education, health, vocational training, etc., through the efforts of voluntary organizations and other organizations.

name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes
brief: The Central Sector Scheme “Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes” was launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India.

name: Scheme to Give Incentive-Prize to Gaushala/ Panjrapole
brief: The "Scheme to Give Incentive-Prize to Gaushala/ Panjrapole" focuses on enhancing the management and operation of Gaushalas and Panjrapoles by offering incentive prizes to the top performers.

name: Scheme to Grant Monthly Financial Assistance to the Persons Engaged in Traditional Occupations/Businesses including Motorcycle Pilots
brief: The scheme aims to provide Social Security and Financial Support for healthy living to those engaged in traditional occupations/businesses and motorcycle pilots. It offers monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000/- to eligible persons of Goan Origin who meet specified age and income criteria.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Grant Scheme
brief: The "Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Grant Scheme" is a scheme by the Dept. of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. Financial assistance of ₹600/- per month is given if there is only one beneficiary in the eligible family, and ₹900/- per month if there is one beneficiary in a family.

name: Scheme for Grant of Pension Benefits to Journalists
brief: The scheme "Scheme for Grant of Pension Benefits to Journalists" offers a monthly pension of ₹6,000/- to qualified journalists who are 58 years or above in age, and have served for a minimum of 20 years in roles such as Full-time Editor, Reporter, Sub-Editor, Press Photographer/Videographer, etc.

name: Surgical Grant For The Prevention Of Disability
brief: The "Surgical Grant for the Prevention of Disability" scheme is started by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and operated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Uttar Pradesh.

name: Scheme For Grant Of Rewards To The Children Of Salt Labourers
brief: The scheme “Scheme for Grant of Rewards to the Children of Salt Labourers” was launched by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry in the year 1985.

name: Scheme for Goa Rajya Vidnyanik Puraskar
brief: The scheme aims to introduce and recognize Goan Innovators/Scientists who have achieved excellence in the fields of Science, Technology, and Innovation. The scheme rewards eligible Students, Startups, Innovators, Research Faculty, and Scientists with three annual cash awards of ₹2,00,000/- each.

name: Good Samaritan Scheme
brief: Launched on 3rd Oct 2021 by the MoRTH, the scheme grants an award to the good samaritan who has saved the life of a victim of a fatal accident (involving a motor vehicle) by administering immediate assistance and rushing to the Hospital/Trauma Care Centre within the Golden Hour of the accident.

name: State Government Share Capital Contribution to Co.operative Sugar Factories (Normal Area) (Tribal Area)
brief: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a 30% share capital contribution by the State Government for setting up new sugar cooperative factories in Gujarat.

name: State Government SC Scholarship (Class 1 to 10)
brief: The scheme was launched by School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to improve educational status of SC students by providing scholarships. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to SC girl students in Classes 1 to 5,and to both boys & girls in SC category in Classes 6 to 10.

name: Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)
brief: The scheme aims to re-establish traditional artisan skills among SC/ST communities. It provides free training, infrastructure support, and marketing opportunities to artisans in selected artisan villages.

name: Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme
brief: The Government of Sikkim has introduced the Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme, 2014. This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled students to help them secure academic education and technical or professional training.

name: Scheme for Giving Stipend to the Trainees Belonging to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Community Enrolled under Various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa
brief: The scheme aims to give benefits under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe trainees enrolled under various Labour Welfare Centres in the State of Goa. Eligible trainees receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/- to support their training in crafts.

name: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 1 to 8)
brief: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to give benefits for improving the educational status of scheduled tribe students. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 1 to 8.

name: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)
brief: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students and improve their educational status. This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10.

name: Shaheed Gram Vikas Yojana
brief: The scheme "Shaheed Gram Vikas Yojana" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to develop villages linked to tribal freedom fighters. It provides housing, infrastructure, and other facilities to eligible Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes.

name: Shednet House
brief: The Shednet House provided subsidies to farmers so they could earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetables, flowers, fruits, etc. by controlling the agro-climatic factors, temperature, humidity, and sunlight.

name: Health Benefits for Pregnant Mothers and Newborns through Supraja-AYUSH
brief: The scheme aims to promote the health and well-being of pregnant women and newborns by providing Ayurvedic-based healthcare services and treatment.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to provide Soil Health Cards to all farmers in the state, helping them understand the nutrient composition of their soil and the type and quantity of fertilizers suitable for their crops.

name: Scholarships For Higher Education Abroad To Meritorious Boys And Girls From Open Category
brief: The scheme “Scholarships for Higher Education Abroad to Meritorious Boys and Girls from open category” was launched by the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra on 4th October 2018.

name: Scheme for Hospitals / Nursing Homes (PIPDIC)
brief: The scheme aims to financially assist the entrepreneurs for setting up hospitals/nursing homes. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

name: Vishesh Samman Pension Yojana for the State Agitators who became Disabled and Completely Bedridden during the Uttarakhand State Movement
brief: The scheme aims to honor state agitators who became permanently disabled and bedridden during the Uttarakhand Statehood Movement by providing them with monthly financial assistance of ₹20,000/-.

name: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Assistance to Match Officials, Coaches and Support Personnel
brief: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions.

name: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Fellowship Programme
brief: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions.

name: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports: Publication of Outstanding Works on Sports Related Subjects
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the publication of outstanding works, journals, e-publications, online content, and web-based applications related to sports and games, thereby promoting sports knowledge, research, and awareness among stakeholders and the general public.

name: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 2 - NGO Operated Schools
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The sub-scheme aims to provide quality education and opportunities to students from SC communities through grant-in-aid institutions run by Non-Governmental Organizations and residential high schools, addressing the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector.

name: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 1 - SHRESHTA Schools (Best CBSE Private Residential Schools)
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
