brief: This scholarship is specially designed for students who are pursuing research work. Under the scheme, beneficiaries will get cash awards to conduct their research work.

name: Sant Ravidaas Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana
brief: "Sant Ravidas Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" is a scholarship program launched by the Uttar Pradesh government. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the children of construction workers for their education.

name: Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana
brief: The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.

name: Scheme for Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Charges for Start-ups and Telecom MSEs
issuer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
brief: The scheme aims to reimburse testing and certification costs. Financial support is provided to Start-ups and MSEs to enhance telecom product competitiveness.

name: Scheme for Relief to the Un-registered Workers
brief: The Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board launched a welfare scheme "Scheme for Relief for the Un-registered Workers" to provide the financial assistance to the dependents of unregistered workers who die in accidents at construction sites.

name: Sneha Sparsha
brief: "Sneha Sparsha" is a healthcare scheme by the Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Assam. In this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided for specialized treatment of children below 12 years of age affected with some serious ailments.

name: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0, DNH & DD
short: SS-DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI AND DAMAN & DIU
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: The Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has successfully launched the "Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0" scheme to provide nutritional support for children below 6 years of age, Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), and Adolescent Girls (14-18 years).

name: Santwana Scheme - Karnataka
brief: The "Santwana Scheme" offers loans to religious minority individuals whose houses or shops have been destroyed by natural calamities or communal violence. The scheme provides up to ₹5,00,000/- per unit, with 50% as a loan and 50% as a subsidy

name: Snehapoorvam Scheme
brief: Kerala Government has launched a noble initiative “Snehapoorvam Scheme” to provide financial assistance to orphans who are living in the family, with their relatives, friends, or the support of the community under the Social Welfare Department implemented through Social Security Mission.

name: Shikshashree Scheme
brief: The scheme "Shikshashree Scheme” was implemented by the Government of West Bengal during the year 2014-15  by merging the existing schemes of Book Grants & Maintenance Grants to provide financial assistance to Schedule Caste students studying in classes V to VIII.

name: Sponsorship Scheme (90% Centrally Funded)
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children upto age of 18 years, including those who have lost both parents, those whose main earning parent has died, & children who have suffered due to violation of laws, child labor, child trafficking, child marriage & similar circumstances.

name: Sagar Samman Award- Recognition of Outstanding Maritime Training Institutes
brief: The scheme aims to recognize excellence in maritime education and training by providing rankings and recognition to top maritime institutes.

name: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Excellence
brief: This scheme aims to recognize high-level maritime contributions by providing recognition to individuals with sustained excellence.

name: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Award for Gallantry
brief: Under this scheme, recognition is provided to Indian seafarers who risk their lives to save others or protect the marine environment.

name: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Varuna Award
brief: This scheme aims to recognize outstanding maritime contributions by providing top national recognition to distinguished maritime professionals.

name: scholarship scheme - Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board, Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the sons and daughters of small and marginal farmers, agricultural laborers, and market workers of Uttarakhand to pursue higher education in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, Horticulture & other related fields.

name: Sant Sohirobanath Ambiye Dnyanvruddhi Shishyavrutti- Bursary Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to universalize higher and technical education in Goa by improving access and increasing the Gross Enrollment Ratio. It provides financial assistance for eligible course fees and textbooks to support students pursuing higher and technical education in the state.

name: Saksham Scheme for Backward Classes
brief: Under the scheme, loans of up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided to young professionals for setting up Doctors' Clinics, Nursing Homes, Physiotherapy Clinics, Bio-Medical Labs, Lawyers' Offices, Engineering Units, Chemist Shops, Architect Offices, and similar establishments.

name: Scheme for Small Business Owners of Scheduled Castes to Buy a Place of Business/Shop
brief: Under the scheme, financial assistance in the form of loans and subsidies is provided by banks to individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. This assistance is aimed at enabling them to purchase business premises or shops in urban areas for business development.

name: Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to support traditional faith healers by providing a monthly pension. Under this scheme, ₹1,500 is provided to each eligible traditional healer across the state.

name: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit, 100 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Caste People
brief: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Caste individuals by providing financial assistance for poultry farming.

name: State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th (Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic )
brief: The "State Scholarship for Classes 6th to 10th" scheme provides an annual scholarship ranging from ₹200/- to ₹1,200/- (for 10 months) to the students belonging to De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities studying in classes 6th to 10th.

name: State Senior Citizens Home
brief: The Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Mizoram launched the State Senior Citizens Home for the homeless aged persons. It provides shelter and facilities to homeless elderly individuals aged 60 and above, who lack family support.

name: Scholarship To Scheduled Castes Students Studying In Government ITI’s
brief: The scheme “Scholarship to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Government ITI's” was launched by the Dept. of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana in the year 2017-18. This scheme is implemented through Skill Development and Industrial Training Department, Haryana.

name: Stipend to Scheduled Caste Trainees in Technical Training Institutions
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support to Scheduled Tribe candidates/trainees who are undergoing training in the Government Technical Training Institutions of the Union Territory of Puducherry.

name: Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW) Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to encourage community marriages among economically and socially backward classes. Incentives are provided to couples and the organizing institutions.

name: Scholarship To Son And Daughter Of Differently Abled Persons
brief: The "Scholarship to Son and Daughter of Differently Abled Persons" scheme in Tamil Nadu is a government initiative that aims to provide financial assistance to the children of differently abled individuals for their education.

name: Supply of Sarees and Dhoties to Differently Abled Persons
brief: In this scheme, free dhothies and sarees or equivalent Direct Benefit Transfer are provided to the differently abled persons who are benefited under the monthly financial assistance schemes in lieu of Diwali / Pongal / local regional festivals.

name: Scholarships to Students with Disabilities Scheme
brief: The objective of the scheme is to assist students with disabilities to secure education, academic, technical, or professional training to enable them to earn a living and to become useful members of society.

name: Sona Sobaran Dhoti Saree Distribution Scheme
brief: The "Sona Sobaran Dhoti Saree Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, provides one dhoti/lungi and one saree at a subsidized rate to NFSA and JSFSS beneficiaries to ensure clothing accessibility for low-income families

name: Establishment Of Small Scale Dairy Unit (SSDU)
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: The scheme aims to support the establishment of dairy units with 10 Gir cows. Through this scheme, capital subsidy and back-ended subsidy are provided to beneficiaries via bank finance and NABARD.

name: Saksham Scholarship
brief: The scheme aims to support meritorious differently-abled students pursuing graduate-level studies in the state by providing them with financial assistance in the form of scholarships.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm For Schedule Caste
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide supplementary income to Schedule Caste People of the society.

name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit To Scheduled Tribes
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit to Scheduled Tribes” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Scheduled Tribe People of Gujarat State.

name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ Unit For Scheduled Caste
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ unit for Scheduled Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Schedule Caste People of the society.

name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit For Weaker Section
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit for Weaker Section” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of weaker section people of the society.

name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit For Divyang People
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit for Divyang People” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Divyang People of the society of Gujarat State.

name: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s unit 40 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training
brief: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance and training to economically weaker sections and Divyang individuals in Gujarat for poultry farming.

name: Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for backward class students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

name: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
brief: Under this scheme, a scholarship of ₹15,000 per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemen, from the rank of Sepoy to Havildar, who are pursuing vocational & technical education & have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or from any other source.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Caste People
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Caste People” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For General Category People
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for General Category People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Tribe Women
brief: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Tribe Women” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

name: Shreshtam Scheme For Ensuring Participation Of PwDs In Arts & Sports
brief: The scheme “Shreshtam Scheme for Ensuring Participation of PwDs in Arts & Sports” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Scholarship Scheme for Girl Children of Workers of Jute Mills/MSME JDP Units
brief: National Jute Board Act, 2008 provides to “secure better working conditions and provisions and improve amenities and incentives for workers engaged in the jute industry.”

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement are provided to specially-abled students belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2.00 lakh, who are regularly studying in government and recognized educational institutions.

name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Solar System for fish/shrimp culture
brief: Under this scheme, subsidies on solar systems for fish/shrimp culture are provided to eligible fish and shrimp farmers. The subsidy is given at 60% of the total project cost, or ₹30,000 per kW, whichever is lower. The maximum subsidy is limited to 30 kW for shrimp farmers and 10 kW for fish farmers.

name: Shaktidoot Scheme
brief: The "Shaktidoot Scheme", an initiative by the Gujarat Government in 2006, supports talented sportspersons in achieving excellence at national and international levels by providing need-based sports facilities and financial assistance.

name: Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters
brief: "Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters" aims to honour the third-generation descendants of freedom fighters by providing financial assistance for higher education. Eligible students receive a monthly stipend and an annual allowance for books to support their education.

name: Swayam Saksham Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
brief: The scheme aims to instil a sense of self-reliance among youth pursuing vocational education/training. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided for establishing various professional units

name: Prani Sampad Samruddhi Yojana: Small Scale Goat / Sheep Farming (10+1 Capacity)
brief: The scheme aims to provide livelihood support to the interested beneficiaries to improve the livelihoods of the weaker sections of society. Through this scheme, a subsidy of 60% or 50% of the unit cost is provided to eligible beneficiaries for the establishment of one Goat / Sheep Unit (10+1).

name: Spectacles Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹1,500/- is provided to workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the purchase of spectacles in case of visual impairment.

name: Simon Sing Horo Special Post-Matric Scholarship
brief: The scheme aims to provide a one-time incentive of ₹10,000/- to students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared High School Leaving Certificate or Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate examinations during the current year.

name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm
brief: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for the State Cattle Breeders” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Caste
brief: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Caste” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

name: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Tribe
brief: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Tribe” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat.

name: Special Scheme for Increasing the Storage Capacity of Perishable Products
brief: The scheme aims to increase the storage capacity of perishable products by providing grant assistance for cold storage facilities.

name: Sastraposhini Scheme
brief: Sastraposhini is a programme envisaged by Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE) for strengthening science education in schools of Kerala.

name: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R./Kadaknath & 1000 Broiler Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training for Scheduled Tribes People of the State
brief: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance and training stipends to Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals in Gujarat for poultry farming.

name: Scheme For Soft Loan To The Grant-in-aid/ Non-grant In Aid Institutions For Maintenance And Upgradation Of Infrastructure Facilities
brief: The objective of the scheme is to support the efforts of the management of the Non-Government aided institutions/non-grant-in-aid institutions for the upgradation and maintenance of infrastructural facilities for promoting a conducive atmosphere for learning.

name: Small Scale Lending Scheme (Microfinance)
brief: The scheme aims to provide microcredit to the small entrepreneurs of the target group. It provides loans up to ₹1,25,000/- at 5% interest rate to eligible beneficiaries belonging to the Rabari and Bharwad castes.

name: Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for Minority Caste students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

name: Swavalambi/Sanchari Marata Malige
brief: The "Swavalambi/Sanchari Marata Malige" aims to assist SC leather artisans in establishing their own showrooms or mobile vans to sell their products directly to consumers. Financial assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy depending on the location of the business.

name: Sanskrit Scholarship
brief: Under this scheme, students studying Sanskrit at various levels—Post Graduate (M.A. Classic), Acharya, Graduate (B.A. Classic), Shastri, Uttar Madhyama, Purva Madhyama, and Prathama—in any government or aided non-government college receive a monthly scholarship of ₹300/- for 10 months.

name: Snehayanam Scheme For Mothers Of Persons With Special Needs
brief: The scheme “Snehayanam Scheme for Mothers of Persons with Special Needs” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief: The scheme “Stipends to Students of NT/DNT Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for NT/DNT Caste students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

name: Scheme To Support Orphan Child/Children Of Widows Belonging To Scheduled Tribe Community
brief: The scheme aims to provide crucial financial support for food, clothing, and shelter to children of widows and orphans belonging to the ST community Benefits include a monthly fixed maintenance allowance of ₹1,500/- for a widow’s child or ₹2,000/- for an orphan.

name: State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th (Scheduled Caste)
brief: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a scholarship amount of ₹200/- to Scheduled Caste students, which is disbursed until 31st October every year.

name: State Scholarship of Class 6th to 10th (Scheduled Caste)
brief: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP. It provides ₹200 per year for boys and ₹600 per year for girls from Scheduled Caste communities, until 31st October.

name: Stipend Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Stipend Scheme'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial support as stipend for the education of children of registered construction workers, including hostel fees, and extends to evening classes for the workers themselves.

name: Shagun Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: The "Shagun Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial support for the marriage of up to two daughters of registered workmen, including daughters who are registered beneficiaries.

name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Divyang People
brief: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Divyang People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of Divyang poultry farmers through scientific poultry farming training.

name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Schedule Caste
brief: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Scheduled Caste by scientific poultry farming training.

name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Weaker Section
brief: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Weaker Section” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers by scientific poultry farming training.

name: Swasraya Scheme For Parents/Mothers Of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons
brief: The scheme “Swasraya Scheme for Parents/Mothers of Physically Handicapped/Mentally Retarded Persons” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Social Security Pension Scheme
brief: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹500/- is provided to Below Poverty Line (BPL) Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) and dwarf individuals to support them in living a respectful life.

name: Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana
brief: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Silicosis (Bimari) Se Pidit Shramiko Ke Liye Aarthik Evam Punarvas Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 16 January 2018.

name: Sugarcane Seed Replacement Programme / Production Enhancement Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to increase sugarcane productivity & improve sugar recovery by promoting cultivation of high-quality, high-yielding, & newly developed sugarcane varieties, while providing farmers with financial support, modern cultivation techniques, & access to advanced agricultural technology.

name: Shrama Shakthi Scheme
brief: Under the Shrama Shakthi Loan scheme, religious minority community entrepreneurs will be trained in artistic and technical skills and will be provided a loan of ₹50,000/- with a 4% rate of interest, to be paid in 36 installments.

name: Salary Subsidy Scheme
brief: Launched in 2018, the "Salary Subsidy Scheme" by the Dept of Information Technology, Govt of Goa. The objective is to provide a Salary Subsidy to the eligible IT Units in Goa. The subsidy would be provided as a matching grant to the salary paid to Fresher up to ₹10,000 per Fresher per month.

name: Sant Surdas Scheme
brief: Under the scheme, monthly financial assistance is provided to Persons with Disabilities aged between 0 and 17 years, who have a disability of more than 80% and are registered in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list.

name: Special Scholarship to Students Belonging to the Most Backward Castes among Scheduled Castes (Vandaniya Sant Shri Vasiyadada Scholarship)
brief: This scheme offers special scholarships to students from the Most Backward Castes among the Scheduled Castes category who are enrolled in Standards I to X.

name: Scholarship/Stipend to SC Students for ITI/Professional Courses (Swami Vivekanand Scholarship)
brief: Under the scheme, a monthly stipend/scholarship will be given to Scheduled Caste Category students who are studying professional courses in Government or Private Industrial Training Institute (ITI).

name: Special Scholarship to SC Students in Selected Schools
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to SC students studying in famous private selected schools i.e. Doon School, Dehradun; Sofiya School, Abu; Mayo school, Ajmer; Sainik School, Balachadi; Mahila Sainik School, Kherva; Dist. Mehsana, etc. will be paid actual fees upto limit of ₹50,000/- p.a.

name: Samriddhi – Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups
brief: The scheme aims to provide opportunities for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students to design, launch, and run their own business or startup after formal education is completed or during their final year of education. The scheme provides a limited one-time financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/-.

name: Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
brief: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Dept., Gujarat, supports education for Socially and Educationally Backward Classes students by providing a monthly stipend of ₹400/-.

name: Swayam Saksham Yojana (GBCDC)
brief: This scheme aims to instill a sense of self-reliance in the youth belonging to backward classes after receiving vocational education/training. Under this scheme, eligible youth are provided loans at a low-interest rate to start self-employment ventures.

name: Swayam Saksham Yojana (GTKVN)
brief: The scheme aims to promote economic self-reliance among professionally educated unemployed youth from Thakor & Koli communities, aged between 18 & 35 years, who hold degrees in fields such as Pharmacy, Software/Hardware, Automobile Engineering, Law, Chartered Accountancy, & others.

name: Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities
brief: The "Subsidy Scheme for Self-help Groups of Minorities" aimed at empowering minority women by providing financial support to Self-Help Groups (SHGs). The scheme offers a subsidy to SHGs engaged in various self-employment activities, promoting economic self-reliance among minority women.

name: Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme offers financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand enrolled in classes 6 to 12 at Sainik Schools outside the state, with scholarships awarded based on family income.

name: Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship
brief: The scheme provides monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to meritorious students who qualify in eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand. The scholarship is awarded to the next 5 students from each development block of Uttarakhand who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship.

name: Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme
brief: Launched on 15th August 1972, "Swatantrata Sainik Samman Pension Scheme" is a Pension Scheme by the Ministry of Home Affairs. The scheme provides the grant of pension to living freedom fighters and their families; if they are no more alive, and to the families or martyrs.

name: Samagr Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana
brief: Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Samagr Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana" for different age groups.

name: Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram
brief: The scheme aims to award financial scholarships to eligible boys of Mizoram domicile who are admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip, specifically to foster their development and prepare them for future entry into the officer’s cadre of the Armed Forces. Benefits include coverage for School Fee, etc.

name: Scholarship Scheme for Students Studying in Government Colleges
brief: Under this scheme, scholarships of ₹3,000, ₹2,000, and ₹1,000 are provided annually to Science, Commerce, and Arts students to promote higher education.

name: Stipend Scheme For Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend
brief: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Schedule Tribes through scientific poultry farming training.

name: Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme
brief: The scheme “Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme” was started by the Department of Education, Himachal Pradesh. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to the students of Himachal Pradesh who are studying in Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra.

name: Swanath Scholarship Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial support to diploma and graduate-level students who are orphans, whose parents or either parent has died due to COVID-19, or who are dependents of martyrs from the military or central armed forces.

name: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridh Ashram Mai Nivaasarat Ant-vasi Pension Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to the citizens who live in old age homes recognized by the Department of Social Justice.

name: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
brief: Initiative of the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the Madhya Pradesh started the scheme "Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridhavastha Pension Yojana" for the older age people of the state.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (PLI 1.2) for Specialty Steel
brief: under this scheme to promote domestic manufacturing of specialty steel by encouraging incremental investment, increasing production of value-added steel, enhancing technological capabilities, and reducing import dependence while generating employment.

name: Shilp Sampada Term Loan Scheme for Backward Classes- Haryana
brief: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹10,00,000/- to artisans & handicraft persons from backward classes to preserve traditional arts and crafts. The scheme also offers training to upgrade their existing skills with the latest technological inputs, such as the use of computers, CAD, etc.

name: Social Security for Tea Plantation Workers in Assam
brief: The scheme aims to provide institutionalized social security cover, including provident funds, pensions, and life insurance. It provides monthly pensions, provident fund advances, and lump-sum death benefits to tea plantation workers in Assam and their dependent families.

name: Sanctioning Spectacles to Senior Citizens
brief: The "Sanctioning Spectacles to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide spectacles to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to improve their vision and enhance their quality of life.

name: Saphalam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses
brief: The scheme “Saphalam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

name: Scheme for Supply of TV Sets to Industrial Establishments/Labour Welfare Centres/Clubs/Recreation Rooms
brief: "Scheme for Supply of TV Sets to Industrial Establishments/Labour Welfare Centres/Clubs/Recreation Rooms" by the Dept of Labour and Employment, Goa aims to provide television sets to enable the workers/employees to witness programmes of nation national integration besides broadening their outlook.

name: Scheme for Setting Up of Centre of Excellence
brief: The scheme aims to provide strategic funding for collaborative research and development in the chemicals and petrochemicals sector. It provides a grant of up to ₹5,00,00,000/- to existing Government universities and organizations for research equipment, staff, and technology commercialization.

name: Scheme for Setting Up of Industrial Estates
brief: The scheme aims to assist organizations (Public Limited Companies, Private Limited Companies, Partnerships, Sole Proprietary, and Municipalities) for setting up of industrial estates for exclusive allotment of sheds/plots to SSI units. The applications for this scheme are accepted online only.

name: Scheme for Setting Up of Plastic Parks
brief: The scheme aims to increase the competitiveness and value addition in the plastic processing industry through cluster development. It provides grant-in-aid up to ₹40,00,00,000/- for common infrastructure benefits intended for Special Purpose Vehicles and local enterprises.

name: Sabji Shetra Vistar Yojana
brief: Under the Sabji Shetra Vistar yojana, selection of vegetables through quality high yielding varieties to expand the area of crops and increase production.

name: Scholarship Scheme for Worker's Children- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
brief: The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Haryana. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to children of workers & workers employed in industrial and commercial institutions of Haryana state to continue their studies.

name: Subsidized Scheme for Widows: Haryana Women Development Corporation
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana Domiciled Widow, Divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided.

name: Solar Water Pumping System
brief: The scheme "Solar Water Pumping System" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana aims to encourage the adoption of renewable energy for irrigation. Through this scheme, solar water pumps are provided at a 75% subsidy to eligible farmers and institutions for irrigation need

name: Shramashakthi Special Women's Scheme
brief: The "Shramashakthi Special Women's Scheme" is a special scheme for the economic empowerment of widowed, divorced, unmarried women of the minority community.

name: Sheti Samrudhi Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to facilitate community level action for agriculture growth and management of natural resources. It offers financial assistance, wages for personnel, and funding for necessary office equipment for Tribal Farmers Co-operative.

name: Saur Sujala Yojana
brief: The Saur Sujala Yojana is to set up solar irrigation pumps for the irrigation needs of the farmers. The scheme has been started on November 01, 2016, with the aim of empowering the farmers by providing irrigation pumps to the farmers at subsidized rates.

name: Sukhad Sahara Yojana
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹500/- per month are provided to the widows and deserted women who are living below poverty line (BPL) to support them in living a respectful life.

name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9
brief: Under this scheme, free bicycle assistance is provided to economically backward class girls studying in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aid schools across Gujarat.

name: Shilpi Samridhi Yojana
brief: "Shilpi Samridhi Yojana" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Govt of Haryana. Through this scheme, loans/benefits are provided to the families of the scheduled caste artisans to pursue various economic development activities.

name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Socially and Educationally Backward Girls studying in Class 9th
brief: Under this scheme, free bicycle assistance is provided to Socially and Educationally Backward class girls studying in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aid schools across Gujarat.

name: Samaaveshit Shiksha
brief: The scheme aims to provide equal and inclusive educational opportunities to all children with special needs (Divyang children) studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.

name: Shauchalaya Sahayata Yojana
brief: The "Shauchalaya Sahayata Yojana" is a scheme by the government of Uttar Pradesh, India, to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers to build toilets in their homes.

name: Subsistence and Transport Allowance to Disabled Students for Pursuing Education in Computer and Management
brief: The scheme was implemented by Higher Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide incentives to disabled students. This scheme benefits students pursuing computer/management courses at government colleges, provided their annual parental/guardian income does not exceed ₹1.00 lakh.

name: Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists
brief: The "Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage the postgraduate and graduate students of the Government College of Fine Arts, Chennai & Kumbakonam by awarding scholarships every year.

name: S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government Primary, Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students
brief: The scheme aims to provide concession in bus fare fees to the students studying in Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary, and Higher Secondary Technical Education in Government and Non-Government schools. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC).

name: Supply of Tri-Cycles (CBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, Tri-Cycles will be provided by the Board to the disabled registered construction workers and their dependents, once in life time.

name: Scheduled Tribe Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
brief: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.

name: Scholarship to Disabled Students
brief: The scheme "Scholarship to Disabled Students" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department aims to provide financial assistance to students with disabilities. Through this scheme, annual scholarships are offered to support the education of eligible students from Class 1 onwards.

name: STEM Lab
brief: It aims to promote hands-on learning in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics by establishing labs across all blocks, giving students and teachers practical exposure to STEM experiments.

name: Stipend to Educated Unemployed
brief: Under this scheme, provides a stipend of ₹650 per month to assist 25 educated persons with disabilities who have registered in an Employment Exchange for over three years and have not been placed in gainful employment.

name: Short Term Financial Assistance To Good Borrowers
brief: The scheme aims to meet short term financial requirements related to executing specific orders, seasonal fund increases, or firm export orders. Benefits include loans ranging from ₹5,00,000/- to ₹50,00,000/-, primarily targeting existing Medium Scale Industry and Small Scale Industry units.

name: Short Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
brief: The scheme aims to provide short-term advanced training and financial support to medical and health research personnel to enhance their skills and promote research in priority health areas.

name: ST Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
brief: The scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe girl students of Madhya Pradesh enrolled in Class 11 to encourage them to continue their education and prevent dropouts.

name: Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)
brief: The "Scheme to Increase Seed Replacement Rate (SRR)" by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve crop productivity through providing certified seeds at subsidized rates to all farmers across the state.

name: Stipends To Trainees In Industrial Training Institute
brief: The scheme “Stipends to Trainees in Industrial Training Institute” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra for Scheduled Caste students in Industrial Training Institute.

name: Supply of Tool Kits to their Trained Workers
brief: The A.P. Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board launched a welfare scheme "Supply of Tool Kits Karnataka" provides toolkits to construction workers who have undergone skill upgradation training in trades such as masonry, electrical, and plumbing.

name: Soil Testing Laboratory
brief: Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare Department launched the "Soil Testing Laboratory" scheme for the farmer on 01 April 2013.

name: Short Term Loan Scheme
brief: "Short Term Loan Scheme" provides financial assistance/ loan as a credit to individuals from the Scheduled Tribe Community to meet the immediate expenses towards Education, Medical and Business needs. The scheme aims to improve their standard of living.

name: Seed Testing Laboratory Scheme
brief: The objective of the scheme is to assist seed testing services to farmers to ensure the viability and purity of seed to be sown.

name: Specialized Treatment & Medical Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
brief: The Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides up upto ₹2,00,000/- for specialized medical treatment in Hospitals having tie-ups with Government General Hospitals. The amount for the medical treatment is credited through DBT into the bank account.

name: Scholarship to Meritorious Sportspersons
brief: The scheme aims to encourage and nurture budding sports talent. Annual scholarships are provided to eligible meritorious student sportspersons based on their sports achievements.

name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance for the Production and Publication of Excellent Original Children's Literature
brief: The scheme aims to promote high-quality literary works for children by providing financial support to Gujarati authors for publishing original, unpublished children's books that contribute to cultural and moral development.

name: Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired
brief: The "Sanctioning of Touch Phone to Hearing Challenged – Speech Impaired" aims to provide touch phones to hearing and speech-impaired individuals who know sign language as per the Action Plan 2017-18. The Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Different, distribute the touch phones.

name: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
brief: In the year 1984, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of the Schedule Tribe.

name: Scheme to Promote Mechanization for the Development of Horticulture
brief: The scheme aims to promote mechanization for the development of horticulture by providing subsidies to farmers for purchasing modern agricultural machinery used in horticultural crops.

name: Scheduled Tribe Purvadasham Scholarship Scheme (Class 1 to 8) - Uttarakhand
brief: The aim of this scheme is to help Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 8th by giving them financial support so they can continue their education without any financial difficulty.

name: Short Term Professional Training Courses
brief: The "Short Term Professional Training Courses" is provided to train the youth of the Scheduled Tribe Community in order to start their own business, and to acquire skills by joining the various training courses for the purpose of self-employment or for their livelihood.

name: Scheme for Tourism-related Activities
brief: The scheme aims to financially assist entrepreneurs for setting up or development of amusement parks, cultural centres, convention centres, restaurants, tourist service agencies, including expansion and modernization project. The applications for scheme are accepted online through PIPDIC portal.

name: Scheduled Tribe Relief Scheme
brief: Launched on 31st March 2017, the "Scheduled Tribe Relief Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides immediate support for destitute tribal brides and assistance to disabled, elderly, blind, and impoverished individuals.

name: Startup Manipur
brief: The state government of Manipur has introduced the 'Startup Manipur' initiative, aimed at promoting sustainable economic development and generating significant employment opportunities in the region.

name: Scholarship For Transgender Students
brief: The scheme “Scholarship for Transgender Students” was launched by the Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala for providing scholarships to Transgender students from 7th standard onwards studying in State Government/ Government aided/ Self Financing schools.

name: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
brief: The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

name: State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII)
brief: The scheme “State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII)” was launched by the Education Department, Government of Meghalaya.

name: Scholarships to Students Studying in Central Government Institution like IIT, IIM, IIIT, NIT and Central Universities
brief: The scholarship provides financial assistance to students from Tamil Nadu's BC, MBC, and DNC communities pursuing UG/PG courses at premier Central Government institutions like IITs, IIMs, IIITs, NITs, and Central Universities.

name: State Technical Scholarship for ST Student
brief: The financial assistance is provided to students of Scheduled Tribe Communities who are pursuing Diploma/ Degree/Post Graduated/course in Engineering Institutes recognized by All India Council for Technical Education and, also provided to students who are pursuing UG or PG in Forestry courses.

name: Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna
brief: The scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimage travel for senior citizens of Gujarat by providing financial assistance for travel expenses. It benefits eligible senior citizens through reimbursements or direct arrangements with authorized travel agents.

name: Scholarship To 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers Undergoing D.El.Ed Programme At DIETs And CTTC Sohra
brief: The scheme “Scholarship to 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers undergoing D.El.Ed Programme at DIETs and CTTC Sohra” was launched by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Meghalaya in 2012. The scheme offers a scholarship of ₹5000 p.m. for 2 years (10 months per year) to attract the state's best talent.

name: Su-Swastha Yojana
brief: "Su-Swastha Yojna" provides comprehensive and affordable healthcare coverage to the employees of the Government of Sikkim and their families. Cashless hospitalization at top-tier hospitals across India is provided to eligible beneficiaries with the best-in-class healthcare.

name: Scholarship to Undergo Advanced Training in the Field of Art
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide facilities to Goan talented students to undergo advanced training in the field of various disciplines of Art, i.e. Indian Classical Music and Dance, Drama, Western Music, Folk Art, Puppetry, Painting, Sculpture, etc.. Scholarship of ₹3,000/- per month.

name: SUBHADRA
brief: “SUBHADRA” Scheme is a flagship initiative by the Government of Odisha aimed at financially empowering women, improving their socio-economic status, and promoting their safety and well-being.

name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Transportation through Tracking Devices
brief: The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial allowance for upgrading transportation infrastructure by installing tracking devices on goods carriers. It offers a reimbursement of 50% of the installation expenditure, capped at ₹5,000/- (Indian Rupees 5,000/-) per device, to eligible entities.

name: Skill Up-Gradation with Job/Placement (SUJOP Scheme)
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide employment opportunities, after training, to persons with disabilities (40% or more), helpless or widowed women, former residents of care institutions, and candidates from SC, OBC, and minority communities in Himachal Pradesh.

name: Skill Development Training - 15 Days Residential Skill Up-gradation Training Programme
brief: The Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers a comprehensive 15-day residential skill up-gradation training program designed to enhance the skills of registered construction workers.

name: Stand-Up India
brief: A scheme by Ministry of Finance for financing SC/ST and  Women Entrepreneurs by facilitating bank loans for setting up a greenfield project  Enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading sector and activities allied to agriculture.

name: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan Yojana
brief: The scheme aims to provide assured, dignified, and completely free healthcare services to all pregnant women, mothers, and newborns at public health facilities.

name: Skill Upgradation Program Karnataka
brief: The "Skill Upgradation Program Karnataka" scheme aims to upgrade the skills of artisans in leather technology, footwear/leather goods making, and designing by sending them for advanced training at renowned institutions like CFTI Chennai, CLRI, and Karnataka Institute of Leather Technology.

name: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to other than SC/ST Boys Students of Std I to VIII
short: SUPPLY OF SCHOOL UNIFORM AND TIE BELT
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to other than SC/ST Boys Students of Std I to VIII studying in Govt Schools

name: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to SC/ST Boys/ Girls Students of Std I to VIII
short: SUPPLY OF SCHOOL UNIFORM, TIE BELT
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to SC/ST Boys/ Girls Students of Std I to VIII studying in Govt Schools

name: Supply of School Stationery to all Students for IX to XII
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Supply of School Stationery to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

name: Supply of School Stationery, Socks, Shoes, School Bag, etc. to all Students of Std I to VIII
short: SUPPLY OF STATIONERY, SOCKS, SHOES, SCHOOL BAG
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Supply of School Stationery, Socks, Shoes, School Bag, etc. to all Students of Std. I to VIII studying in Govt Schools

name: Supply of Textbook to all Students for IX to XII
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Supply of Textbook to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

name: Supply of School Uniform , Shoes Socks to all Students for Std IX to XII
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: Supply of School Uniform, Shoes Socks to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to select States/UTs for Skill Development in Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) sector
issuer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
brief: The scheme aims to enhance skill development capacity in the ESDM sector. Through this scheme, financial assistance and industry-relevant training are provided to students and unemployed youth.

name: Scheme for Upliftment of Utsavi Rangabhumi of Goa
brief: The “Scheme for Upliftment of Utsavi Rangabhumi of Goa” has been designed with the objective of encouraging the festival theatre of Goa which is known as “Gomantakiya Utsavi Rangabhumi”. This form of theatre has an illustrious tradition of presenting plays during festivals in the villages.

name: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Children'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides full course fees, boarding and lodging assistance to the children of registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions.

name: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
brief: "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides full course fees, boarding and lodging assistance to the registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions.

name: Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme
brief: The scheme “Sikkim Unmarried Women Pension Scheme (SUWPS)” was launched in 2013 by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Govt. of Sikkim. Under this scheme, the unmarried women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Sikkim would receive a pension of ₹ 2000/- per month.

name: Swami Vivekananda Assam Youth Empowerment
brief: Swami Vivekananda Assam Youth Empowerment (SVAYEM) Scheme is a flagship program by Govt. of Assam to provide financial support to the youths of Assam to take up income-generating activities in the manufacturing, trading, and service sector. This program was launched in the year 2017.

name: Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme
brief: This scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimages to Varanasi and Amritsar for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. The scheme provides financial reimbursement for second-class train travel, enabling eligible beneficiaries to undertake these religious journeys with ease.

name: Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana
brief: A scheme for providing financial assistance to the craftsmen of Cottage Industries through Nationalised Banks, Cooperative banks, Public sector Banks or Private Banks.

name: Swami Vivekananda Exam Oriented Residential Training
brief: The scheme aims to provide exam-oriented residential training for aspiring candidates seeking recruitment in defence and police forces. It offers comprehensive coaching and preparation for Army, Air Force, Navy, Paramilitary and Police recruitment examinations.

name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
brief: "Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship" started by the Higher Education Department of West Bengal State for the financial assistance to the student.

name: Scholarships to Meritorious Students of Sanskrit Schools
brief: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing scholarships to meritorious students of Prathmik Madhyama (Class 10) and Uttar Madhyama (Class 12) in Sanskrit schools who secure the highest marks.

name: Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana
brief: “Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana ” is a Social Security Scheme by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The aim of the scheme is to provide social security to differently abled people aged five(5) years and above.

name: Swami Vivekananda Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 11th & 12th)
brief: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools, whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
brief: A fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for Single Girl Child for research in Social Sciences with an aim to compensate for direct costs of higher education, especially for such girls who happen to be the only girl child in their family.

name: Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Technical Diploma in Professional Courses
brief: The scheme aims to support ST students enrolled in ITIs and recognized training institutes by providing a monthly stipend of ₹400 for a duration of 12 months.

name: Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana
brief: The scheme “Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. An amount of ₹ 18,000/- per year will be given to the general category students for two successive years after matric. 2000 scholarships are awarded every year.

name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Free Distribution of Bicycles - DNH&DD
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: “Free Distribution of Bicycles'' under “Saraswati Vidya Yojana”, implemented by the Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide bicycles free of cost to all the girl students, studying in class VIII(8) in the Govt. schools.

name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses - DNH&DD
issuer: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
states: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
brief: “Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/ Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses'' under “Saraswati Vidya Yojana”, implemented by the Directorate of Education,  Of DNH & DD, aims to provide financial assistance to girl students pursuing higher education in professional courses.

name: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
brief: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of scholarship shall be granted to the children/wards of workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in 10th, 12th & Graduation.

name: Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families
brief: "Scheme for Wage Compensation to Handloom Weaver Families" by the Dept. of Handlooms & Textiles, Andhra Pradesh aims to provide wage compensation relief to handloom weaver families. A relief assistance of ₹4,000 per weaver family is provided to compensate for wage loss during the rainy season.

name: Scheme For Welfare Of Children In Need Of Care And Protection
brief: "Scheme for Welfare of Children in Need of Care and Protection" is a Social Welfare Scheme by the Directorate of Women & Child Development, Govt. of Goa. The objective of this scheme is to assist the Voluntary Organizations that cater to the needs of destitute and orphans up to the age of 18 years.

name: Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)
brief: The scheme "Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Haryana, aims to promote the use of solar energy for domestic water heating by providing a financial subsidy to the residents of Haryana and Haryana Government employees residing in Chandigarh.

name: Solar Water Heater Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
brief: The scheme aims to promote the use of solar energy for water heating in the state to reduce dependence on conventional electricity and fossil fuels, and to encourage the adoption of green and sustainable energy sources in Uttarakhand.

name: Scheme For Waiver Of Loans To Handloom And Powerloom Sector
brief: "Scheme for Waiver of Loans to Handloom and Powerloom Sector" redeems the debt accrued by the farmers, Self-Help Groups, Weavers, etc., to the Scheduled Commercial Banks/Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks, and RRBs, through their Branches/Institutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

name: Student Welfare Scheme
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance to economically weaker ST students to meet their emergency needs in special circumstances. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to ST students studying in Class 1 to 10 in cases of urgency or emergency.

name: Single Window Scheme (PIPDIC)
brief: The scheme aims to provide term loan for fixed assets and loan for working capital through the same agency the total working capital requirement of such units inclusive of all fund based facilities may be taken into account for determining the working capital facility eligible for finance.

name: State Welfare Scheme For Purohits
brief: The scheme "State Welfare Scheme for Purohits" was launched in September 2020 to benefit the financially distressed practicing temple /tribal purohit or priests of other communities like Christians, Jain, and Buddhists.

name: Shahari Waqf Sampatti Vikas Yojana
brief: Under the scheme, interest free loan to Waqf Boards (WBs)/waqf institutions is granted to various Waqf Boards and Waqf Institutions in the country for construction of economically viable buildings on the Waqf land, such as commercial complex, marriage halls, hospitals, cold storage etc..

name: Shagun Yojana
brief: The "Shagun Yojana" aims to assist BPL families with financial aid for the marriage of their daughters. A grant of ₹31,000 is provided to the girl/women.

name: Saksham Yuva Scheme
brief: The scheme “Saksham Yuva Scheme” was launched by the Employment Department, Government of Haryana on 1st November, 2016 on the occasion of Haryana Swarn Jyanti to provide unemployment allowance & honorarium to the eligible post-graduate youth of Haryana.

name: Skilled Youth Startup Scheme
brief: Sikkim Skilled Youth Startup Scheme was launched in 2020 and is implemented by the Department of Commerce & Industries which aims at assisting the educated unemployed youth in setting up a myriad of enterprises through loans with back-ended financial subsidy assistance.

name: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Supply of Yarn to Societies etc. at Subsidized Rate
brief: “Supply of Yarn to Societies etc. at Subsidized Rate" is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal aims to  provide supply of subsidized yarn to the PWCS, Khadi Weavers' Societies etc.

name: Tholkappiar Award
brief: The scheme "Tholkappiar Award" was launched by the Arts and Culture Department, Puducherry. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to writers and authors for outstanding research publications in Tamil literature.

name: Technology Acquisition Assistance
brief: The scheme aims to support Micro and Small enterprises in state to acquire advanced technology/ software related to their production/ manufacturing processes through assistance towards cost incurred for technology/ software acquisition.

name: Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations
brief: The "Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations" scheme provides financial assistance to non-reserved category students who are undergoing training in recognized institutions for competitive recruitment examinations.

name: Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence
brief: The scheme “Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)” was launched by Science & Engineering Research Board, Department of Science & Technology, Government of India which aims to facilitate mobility of faculty members working in State Universities /Colleges/Private Academic institutions.

name: Tablet Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students of 12th Standard
brief: Under the scheme, students in the 12th standard belonging to the Scheduled Caste category will receive a tablet by paying a token fee of ₹1,000/-.

name: Tool Assistance Scheme for Pottery Artisans
brief: The scheme aims to provide essential tools like electric chalk and electric footmill to individual artisans with a 75% subsidy. It benefits pottery workers, particularly those of Prajapati/Kumbhar caste, by offering instrumental assistance and requiring a 25% beneficiary contribution.

name: The Artist Welfare Fund Of Assam
brief: The scheme "The Artist Welfare Fund of Assam" is a scheme of financial asssistance by the Assam State Film (Finance and Development) Corporation, Department of Cultural Affairs, Govt. of Assam. The scheme extednds to the whole of Assam.

name: Trade and Business Sector Scheme (HSFDC)
brief: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from BPL families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural & urban areas for various self-employment income-generating activities such as running a stationery shop, kiryana shop, cloth shop, etc.

name: Tricycles - Tamil Nadu
brief: The Department launched the 'Tricycles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute tricycles to deserving orthopedically differently abled persons affected by both lower limbs for their easy mobility

name: Tirth Barat Yojana
brief: The objective of this scheme is to provide government assistance for pilgrimage to the senior citizens & Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), who are residents of Chhattisgarh, to visit one or more of the various designated pilgrimage sites outside the state, once in their lifetime.

name: Tiatr Competition
brief: The "Tiatr Competition" aims to encourage and promote the unique Goan theatre form of Tiatr. Participation in this scheme is open to Goan institutions registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (with renewed registration). Entries are invited through press notes in local dailies.

name: Trekking in Coastal Area for Scheduled Caste
brief: The scheme "Trekking in Coastal Area for Scheduled Caste" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Dept., aims to promote cultural awareness and coastal resource understanding by organizing guided trekking tours for Scheduled Caste youths aged 15 to 35 across the coastal region of Sagarkantha.

name: Training/Capacity Building Programmes/Research work on Remote Sensing and GIS Applications
brief: The scheme aims to strengthen scientific and technical capacity of researchers, students, and government personnel in the field of Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System (GIS) applications by providing training, conducting capacity-building programmes, and supporting research initiatives.

name: Travel Concession To The Differently Abled Persons In State Owned Transport Corporation Buses
brief: The Government of Tamil Nadu introduced Differently Abled Persons In Stated Owned Tranportat Corporation buses.

name: Top Class Education For Scheduled Caste Students
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: The Scheme aims at recognising and promoting quality education amongst students belonging to SCs by providing financial support. The Scheme will cover SC students for pursuing studies beyond the 12th class.

name: Top Class Education For Students With Disabilities
issuer: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
brief: A scholarship scheme by DoEPwDs for Students with Disabilities (SwDs) pursuing studies beyond class 12th admitted in a full-time course in one of the 'notified institutions'.

name: Tiatr Competition for Educational Institutions at Higher Secondary/College/University Level
brief: The scheme aims to encourage and develop Tiatr activities among students of educational institutions. It provides financial support and awards to participating institutions for staging traditional Tiatr performances in competition format.

name: Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons
brief: The Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons scheme offers vocational courses for specially-abled individuals, funded by the Government of Mizoram. The centers provide courses in tailoring for females and tailoring/shoemaking for males, with a monthly stipend of ₹250 for the training period.

name: The CM IT Fellowship Program
brief: The scheme aims to empower young professionals with technical expertise to address state-level governance challenges through technology. It offers a 2-year M.Tech program in DSAI, hands-on government project experience, and a monthly stipend of ₹50,000/- to eligible youth of Chhattisgarh.

name: Tuber Crops Potato, Tapioca, Colocasia
brief: The objective of the scheme is to boost up production and productivity of potato per unit area by providing quality HYV seeds, and equipment at a 50% subsidy.

name: Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition
brief: The "Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition", organised by the Kala Academy under the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, aims to promote singing talent, preserve and revive the tradition of Tiatr songs, and encourage both traditional and new compositions that reflect Goa.

name: Training Classes In Veda/Devaram
brief: The scheme aims to conduct training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham for divine worship/Poojas. It benefits eligible candidates by providing religious training in Saivaite and Vainavaite temples, and provides an honorarium of ₹1,000/- per month to the instructing pandits.

name: The Delhi Family Benefit Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹20,000/- as a one-time lump sum benefit to families facing financial hardship due to the death of their primary breadwinner.

name: Technology Development Fund (TDF) Scheme
brief: Technology Development Fund (TDF) has been established to promote self-reliance in Defence Technology as a part of the 'Make in India' initiative.

name: Temporary Disability (Hospitalization) Relief Scheme
brief: The "Temporary Disability (Hospitalization) Relief Scheme" welfare scheme by the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board offers financial assistance to registered construction workers who face temporary disability due to accidents or diseases.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Motor Driving Training [Light & Heavy Vehicles]
brief: The scheme aims to provide full financial coverage for motor driving training, including courses for Light Motor Vehicles and Heavy Motor Vehicles, specifically recognizing Goa’s future in the transport sector. It benefits eligible Tribal families in Goa whose annual income is below ₹1,20,000/-.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Purchase of Tourist Taxi
brief: This sub-scheme aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) families by providing financial assistance to purchase tourist taxis for self-employment in Goa’s growing tourism industry. It supports tribal households in transitioning from traditional occupations to sustainable livelihood opportunities.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Subsidy for Purchase of Motorcycle
brief: The scheme aims to assist tribal families in Goa to purchase motorcycles for self-employment by offering a government subsidy, thereby promoting economic self-reliance among low-income households.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Tea/Coffee And Coconut Parlor
brief: The scheme aims to attract tourists with better quality mechanized Tea and Coffee shops and tender coconut water parlors, as Goa is a tourist destination, ensuring better hygiene than other restaurants. The scheme provides entire project financing for establishing a parlor.

name: Tea Development Programme in the Hilly Districts of Uttarakhand - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
brief: The scheme aims to promote tea cultivation in the mountainous regions of Uttarakhand, providing sustainable employment, optimal utilization of barren and unused land, and economic upliftment of local farmers.

name: Tea Development and Promotion Scheme (TDPS): Plantation Development for Small Tea Growers (PDSTG): Mechanization for Individual Small Growers
brief: The objective of this component is to increase the production, productivity and quality of tea, overall development of small tea growers to help them move up in the value chain, sustainability of production by promoting organic tea cultivation& climate resilient tea and to make them self-reliant.

name: Tea Development Scheme
brief: The objective of the scheme is to continue the experimental plantation of tea and to find the possibility of growing tea economically as well as on a commercial scale.

name: Technology Development And Utilization Programme For Women
brief: In order to meet the specific needs of women and to enhance the contribution of women towards technology capability building, the “Technology Development & Utilization Programme for Women (TDUPW)” has been formulated by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).

name: TEC Internship Scheme
brief: The ‘TEC Internship Scheme’ intends to engage 25 Interns in order to study/formulate/operationalize/assess various works/projects/policies etc. The internship will provide an opportunity for young scholars to contribute to the TEC work and have insight into the related technical work.

name: Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
brief: Launched on January 1, 2018, the "Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme" provides financial assistance to construction workers registered under the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for the purchase of tools and equipment related to their work.

name: Testing Equipment Scheme
brief: The Government of Haryana launched the Testing Equipment Assistance Scheme to support Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in enhancing product quality through financial aid for procuring testing equipment.

name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Degree Level
brief: The Scholarships will be awarded to the P.G. Courses/Degree Courses level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architecture or any other equivalent course approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Diploma Level
brief: This scholarship will be awarded to students who are pursuing Diploma level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architectural Assistantship or any other equivalent courses as approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE).

name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme for ITI Level
brief: The objective of the scheme is to improve the quality of training by attracting promising trainees belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe & Other Backward Classes & popularize technical training among these categories, so as to make them able to earn their livelihood respectably & honorably.

name: Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme
brief: The objective of the scheme is to identify technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa who are keen to further their expertise. The selected educators/fellows would be sent to Centres of Excellence within the country and abroad to undertake summer school and short-term training.

name: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt Students
brief: The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme namely "Tuition fees and examination fees to Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students.

name: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt/sbc Students Studying In High Schools
brief: The Government of Maharashtra introduced Tuition fees and Examination fees to Vimukta Jati Nomadic Tribes (VJNT)/ Special Backward Classes (SBC) students studying in High Schools scheme to improve interest of VJNT/SBC students.

name: Training of Farmers on Pulses Production Technologies
brief: The “Training of Farmers on Pulses Production Technologies” scheme aims to educate farmers on advanced pulses production technologies to enhance crop yield.

name: Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools
brief: The "Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, reimburses tuition fees for eligible students enrolled in Sainik Schools or Institutions.

name: Testing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
issuer: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
brief: Testing Fee Reimbursement Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe is a sub scheme under National Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hub (NSSH) scheme.

name: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to encourage scholars to undertake research activities in the field of Archaeology of Goa and West Coast based on primary archaeological sources. It offers financial fellowship assistance of up to ₹40,000/- per month to eligible Post-Graduate or PhD scholars for 24 months.

name: Tourist Guide Certification Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to train and certify Goan youth as tourist guides through Basic and Advanced modules. It reimburses fees for the Basic course and sponsors the Advanced curriculum, creating employment and entrepreneurial opportunities in Goa’s tourism sector.

name: Travel Grants To Goan Authors
brief: The objective of the scheme is to enable the Goan writers to come in close contact with the senior writers of a language-region other than their own within India to acquaint them with the writers and the people of that region, and to widen their awareness and sensibility about the country.

name: Travel Grant Scheme for College Teachers/Vice Chancellors/Commission Members
brief: This scheme is for providing financial assistance to permanent teachers of colleges & vice-chancellors of state universities, deemed to be universities & central universities, recognised under section 2(f) and 12 (B) of the UGC Act, to present research papers at international conferences abroad.

name: The Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme
brief: The scheme aims to create sustainable employment, accelerate investment, and support environmentally sustainable industrial development in Goa. It provides financial assistance and incentives under separate target schemes to new and existing Micro, Small, Medium, and Large manufacturing units.

name: The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme
brief: "The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme" aims to encourage journalists to publish commendable news items, articles, or reports, fostering mass awareness. It provides awards, including a cash prize of ₹10,000/-, to eligible journalists in Goa.

name: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
